store_data.about_the_game:
Pygmalion and the Kingdom of Rot is a strategy game built around side-scrolling base defense, deckbuilding, and roguelite decision-making.

You must survive and defend yourself on a side-scrolling battlefield filled with height differences, slopes, ledges, pits, and buildable positions. Enemies attack from multiple directions and steadily push toward your core area. Your job is not simply to stand still and deal damage, but to quickly build, reinforce, and adapt your defenses based on the terrain, available resources, and the pressure of each incoming horde.

The core gameplay revolves around three main elements:

  • First, choose your character.
    The game is not built around a single fixed protagonist. Players can fight as different playable characters, with more characters planned for future expansion. Each character brings different combat options, pressure-handling tools, and deckbuilding directions.

  • Second, play cards to build your defensive line.
    Your main combat tools come from cards. Cards can be used to deploy buildings, place traps, use one-time tactical items, enhance weapons or defensive structures, or provide temporary status effects and resource cycling at critical moments. During each run, you need to gradually shape your deck into a system that can truly come online.

  • Third, hold back wave after wave of zombie hordes.
    Enemies do not attack from just one route. Different terrain layouts change how enemies approach and also change how you should defend. You need to decide where to place firepower, where to build obstacles, which areas should delay enemies, and which zones must be heavily defended. As the battle progresses, you must keep repairing your line, reallocating resources, and preparing for the next wave before the pressure overwhelms you.

  • The game uses a light rogue lite progression structure.
    After each survival round, you can gain new cards, upgrades, relics, or route choices, gradually improving your deck and combat system. You can lean into building suppression, trap-based control, burst tactics through items, or unique strategies built around a specific character. Every push deeper underground becomes a new deckbuilding process.

The focus of the game is not complex storytelling.
It is about using limited resources under escalating pressure to build a defensive system that actually works.

Key Features

  • Side-scrolling defense meets deckbuilding
    This is not a traditional tower defense game, nor is it a pure card game. You must play cards under real-time pressure to deploy defenses, reinforce your position, and respond tactically.

  • Multiple playable characters
    The game is not designed around one fixed protagonist. Different characters provide different combat experiences, and future updates can expand the game with more playstyle routes.

  • Multiple entrances, varied terrain, multi-lane pressure
    Enemies approach from several directions. Slopes, high ground, ledges, pits, and buildable areas all directly affect how you plan your defenses.

  • Buildings, traps, upgrades, and items all shape your deck
    You do not win by relying on a single type of turret. Buildings establish your defensive line, traps control and weaken enemies, items provide emergency burst power, and upgrades determine whether your build can truly come online.

  • Light roguelite progression
    Each run gives you new cards, upgrades, and relics, allowing you to form different build directions and improving replicability.

  • Decision-making over raw numbers
    What matters most is how you use terrain, resources, and your deck to organize a defensive line before the zombie hordes grow out of control.

During each run, you need to gradually shape your deck into a system that can truly come online.

  • Third, hold back wave after wave of zombie hordes.
    Enemies do not attack from just one route. Different terrain layouts change how enemies approach and also change how you should defend. You need to decide where to place firepower, where to build obstacles, which areas should delay enemies, and which zones must be heavily defended. As the battle progresses, you must keep repairing your line, reallocating resources, and preparing for the next wave before the pressure overwhelms you.

  • The game uses a light rogue lite progression structure.
    After each survival round, you can gain new cards, upgrades, relics, or route choices, gradually improving your deck and combat system. You can lean into building suppression, trap-based control, burst tactics through items, or unique strategies built around a specific character. Every push deeper underground becomes a new deckbuilding process.

The focus of the game is not complex storytelling.
It is about using limited resources under escalating pressure to build a defensive system that actually works.

Key Features

  • Side-scrolling defense meets deckbuilding
    This is not a traditional tower defense game, nor is it a pure card game. You must play cards under real-time pressure to deploy defenses, reinforce your position, and respond tactically.

  • Multiple playable characters
    The game is not designed around one fixed protagonist. Different characters provide different combat experiences, and future updates can expand the game with more playstyle routes.

  • Multiple entrances, varied terrain, multi-lane pressure
    Enemies approach from several directions. Slopes, high ground, ledges, pits, and buildable areas all directly affect how you plan your defenses.

  • Buildings, traps, upgrades, and items all shape your deck
    You do not win by relying on a single type of turret. Buildings establish your defensive line, traps control and weaken enemies, items provide emergency burst power, and upgrades determine whether your build can truly come online.

  • Light roguelite progression
    Each run gives you new cards, upgrades, and relics, allowing you to form different build directions and improving replicability.

  • Decision-making over raw numbers
    What matters most is how you use terrain, resources, and your deck to organize a defensive line before the zombie hordes grow out of control.

Choose from different playable characters, deploy buildings, traps, and tactical cards against zombie hordes attacking from multiple entrances, hold your ground, and push ever deeper underground.

store_data.about_the_game:
After School, the Corner Shop Becomes the Battlefield

After School: Days Gone By is a collectible progression game built around childhood toy battles.

Step back into the days when going home after school could wait. Outside the corner shop, beside the schoolyard, or down by the apartment blocks, kids crouch on the ground and settle the day’s bragging rights with glass marbles, round cards, and spinning tops.

At its core, the game is not just a collection of simple minigames. It is a progression loop built around three childhood battle systems:

Marble Battles, Round Card Battles, and Spinning Top Battles.

You will collect toys of different rarities, learn their stats and traits, build your own battle setups, and win new collectibles through match after match.

  • Three Childhood Battle Systems

Marbles: Aim, Angles, and Feel

Marble battles focus on launch angles, collision paths, and reading the field.

Different marbles come with different rarities and properties. Basic two-color marbles, advanced patterned marbles, refined solid-color marbles, rare golden-glow marbles, and more may all differ in feel, weight, bounce, or special traits.

You will need to choose the right marble based on the arena, your opponent’s marble positions, and the current state of the match.

  • Round Cards: Slaps, Flips, and Deckbuilding

Round cards are not only childhood collectibles, but also a major battle system in the game.

Players can build their own deck of round cards. Common cards offer stable performance, while higher-rarity cards may come with unique traits that make every slap more strategic.

Round card battles are not just about execution. They are also about deckbuilding.

Which cards do you bring?

Which one do you play first?

Do you aim for consistent flips, or gamble on a high-reward combo?

Every choice can change the outcome of a match.

  • Spinning Tops: Assembly, Customization, and Counters

The spinning top system emphasizes part combinations and matchup counters.

Each top is made up of multiple components, such as an upper attack ring, blade structure, core shaft, or bottom tip. Different parts affect attack power, defense, stability, stamina, and movement patterns.

Players can buy, collect, dismantle, and customize spinning top parts, even experimenting with unusual combinations to create different styles:

Attack types, stamina types, defense types, rebound types, disruption types, and more.

There is no single strongest top. The key is whether you can read your opponent’s setup and bring the right counter.

  • Collect Rare Toys and Build Your Own Treasure Box

Marbles, round cards, spinning top parts, and hero collectible cards all come with different rarities and collection value.

Some items are common resources you can obtain every day from the corner shop, regular matches, or basic rewards. Others are extremely rare and may only appear through special events, tough rival challenges, hidden shops, or low-probability refreshes.

Your collection is more than numerical progression. It is part of the childhood memory.

The marble you cannot bear to use, the worn-out round card you still keep, the spinning top build that perfectly counters a rival — over time, they will become the prized treasures of your own toy box.

  • Light Roguelite Progression and Battle Choices

The game features light roguelite-style build progression.

In each run, you may encounter different friends, arenas, rewards, and shop refreshes. You will need to adjust your battle strategy based on the collectibles currently in your hands.

Maybe this run gives you a round card combo built for chain flips.

Maybe you buy a rare spinning top tip that enables a high-stamina build.

Maybe you just picked up a special marble that happens to be perfect for challenging a tough rival.

As you keep playing, you will gradually develop your own collection route and battle style.

  • Hero Collectible Cards: Extra Boosts from Childhood Legends

In addition to marbles, round cards, and spinning tops used directly in battles, the game also features special hero collectible cards.

These cards lean more toward collection and support effects. Players can choose a small number to bring along and gain bonuses for different battle systems.

Some cards support marble battles, some enhance round card gameplay, and others affect spinning top builds. They will not replace skill or strategy, but they give you more room to prepare before heading out for another challenge.

Features

  • Childhood-themed collectible battles

Battle and collect around marbles, round cards, and spinning tops, recreating the lively feeling of after-school matches outside the corner shop.

  • Three core gameplay systems

Marbles focus on angles and collisions. Round cards focus on slaps and deckbuilding. Spinning tops focus on assembly and counters.

  • Rarity and trait system

Different toys come with different qualities, stats, and special effects.

  • Round card deckbuilding

Winning is not only about how well you slap the cards, but also how you build your deck and plan your play order.

  • Spinning top customization

Combine different parts to create attack, defense, stamina, disruption, and other build styles.

  • Light roguelite progression

Rewards, opponents, shops, and build directions may change from run to run.

  • Nostalgic, but not stuck in the past

This is not a simple recreation of childhood minigames. It turns childhood toys into a strategic battle system filled with progression, collecting, and the thrill of building your own playstyle.

store_data.about_the_game:
FINAL RITES PROTOCOL

CONFIDENTIAL REPORT, ARCHIVE COPY

OVERVIEW

After a series of unexplained incidents in a remote village in northern Spain, a group of exorcists was dispatched. No further communication was received.

Following the loss of contact, a secondary unit was authorized.

Designation: FINAL RITES.

This unit is not tasked with absolution.

Its purpose is containment.

THE SITUATION

What began as a localized religious disturbance has escalated into a spreading condition affecting the entire region.

The village appears intact, yet abandoned. Signs of daily life remain undisturbed, but no inhabitants are present.

Inside, reality itself shows signs of instability:

  • spaces that do not match their external structure

  • doors leading to unknown locations

  • environments that shift and disorient

THE THREAT

Entities encountered are not fully understood.

The dead do not remain at rest.
Termination does not guarantee neutralization.

Some entities resemble former inhabitants. Others do not correspond to any known form of life.

In multiple cases:

  • movement occurs without visible cause

  • figures appear where no one is present

  • reflections act independently

Destruction alone is insufficient.

Something remains.

BREACHES

Certain locations act as transition points between realities.

These are not conventional portals, but unstable openings where:

  • sound is distorted

  • light behaves irregularly

  • space itself becomes unreliable

Personnel have reported crossing into environments that do not exist within known geography.

Some have not returned.

FAILURE OF EXORCISM

Initial ritual procedures did not eliminate the presence.

They altered it.

What was once contained is now unbound.

The situation is no longer a haunting.

It is a spreading condition.

YOUR ROLE

You are part of the FINAL RITES unit.

A military esoteric squad deployed when exorcism fails.

Your mission is to:

  • investigate corrupted locations

  • engage hostile entities

  • perform sealing rituals

  • contain the spread

You will explore abandoned structures, forests, and underground sites while confronting the aftermath of failed rites.

Some threats can be destroyed.

Others must be bound.

DIRECTIVE

  • Do not rely on standard exorcism procedures

  • Destroy remains when possible

  • Apply sealing rites to stabilize affected areas

  • Do not assume cleared zones remain safe

Engagement alone is insufficient.

What is encountered must be contained.

FINAL NOTE

Recovered records from the first unit include the following:

“We thought it was inside the village.
It is not.
The village is inside it.”

END OF REPORT

store_data.about_the_game:
Donut Smash is a small arcade game about feeding a hungry cat with falling donuts!

Tap the donuts before they hit the floor, break frozen ones, grab coffee when you can, and try not to touch the broccoli. If you miss a donut or tap the wrong thing, the run is over.

It starts simple, but after a while the game gets faster and more chaotic. Power-ups can flip the screen, change the pace, boost your score, or just make everything harder to control.

Runs are short, so it is easy to jump in for one more try. Chase your high score, unlock silly cosmetics, and see how much your cat can eat.

Tap donuts. Feed the cat. Fear the broccoli.

Features

  • Simple one-tap gameplay

  • Short arcade runs

  • Donuts, frozen donuts, coffee, broccoli, and random power-ups

  • High-score chasing

  • Unlockable skins and cosmetics

  • A cat that grows as you score

  • Colorful, silly chaos

The world of Lucrea is not what it once was.

In the aftermath of collapse, what remains is dangerous, forgotten, and largely unexplored. Laban is one such place — a remote, untamed land that your squad didn't choose to land on. But here you are.

Lucrea: Laban is a cooperative PvE extraction shooter with hero shooter mechanics. Each player brings a unique set of abilities to the team, and you'll need all of them. Communication, coordination, and knowing when to use what you've got is the difference between making it out and not making it out.

Explore the world of Laban together, uncover what's been left behind, and find a way home — if you're ready for what you'll discover along the way.

Features

  • Co-op for up to 4 players

  • Hero shooter abilities built around teamwork

  • A rich post-apocalyptic sci-fi/fantasy setting

  • Integrated voice chat

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Neo-Uryupinsk. There is no exit. There is only the update.
“In a world where corporations replaced nations and AI replaced conscience, you are the last failsafe in a system that wants you erased.”

You are Gleb, a “freelance manager” for Global Trust Corporation. You live in a luxurious penthouse overlooking an eternal sunset. You dine on the finest steaks. You converse with your flawless virtual assistant, CHARL.

But why does rusted metal from a prison carriage sometimes flicker through the panoramic glass?
Why does your exquisite dinner smell faintly of bleach and boiled cabbage?

What is this game?

A psychological cyberpunk thriller in the visual novel genre, where the line between reality and simulation has collapsed.

You will make ethical decisions on behalf of an entire corporation-signing death warrants for entire city blocks—while your own mind slowly fractures into lines of code.

But remember: every breath you take is monitored by three algorithms:

  • CHARL - caring, yet disturbingly opaque

  • Sergeant - a paranoid security script

  • The Judge - cold, impartial, absolute

To them, you are either a valuable asset… or biological waste awaiting disposal.

Early Access - Current State & Roadmap

This is an early version of the game, currently featuring the first standalone episode:

Episode 1: “AGE Inc.”

  • ~1.5–2 hours of gameplay

  • ~22K words of narrative content

The full game is planned as a three-episode experience.
Episodes 2 and 3 will expand the story with an additional:

  • ~2–3 hours of gameplay combined

  • ~60K+ words of narrative content

Why play?

A Reality with Layers
Explore 5 hyper-stylized “mini-horrors” embedded within the main narrative. Each is a distorted genre thriller-from American slasher to Soviet depressive noir-rendered in a bold, uncompromising visual style.

Gameplay as Survival
Your progress is inseparable from your performance in mini-games. These aren’t distractions-they are tools to deceive the AI surveillance system.

Story & Tone
Sharp, ironic dialogue. Deep metaphysical themes of digital servitude. And the bitter humor of someone who already knows the serial number of the axe meant for them.

The Bio-Drone System
Can you outplay the superintelligence “Unburnt Sun” using fragments left behind by failed predecessors? Or will you become just another branch in the corporation’s main update package?

Familiar Mechanics - Reimagined

7 unique mini-games, each reinterpreted within the world of Neo-Uryupinsk:

  • Combat Brick Crusher - Arcade-style battles against security firewalls

  • Classic “Durak” - A psychological duel with Sergeant, where your memory is at stake

  • Domino Reimagined - Build logical chains to bypass corporate restrictions

  • The Memory Trials - Over 100 symbolic fragments to reconstruct the truth hidden behind CHARL’s filters

  • Mahjong - A meditative purge of digital noise from your consciousness

  • Tactical Inventory - Assemble gear in the “real world” (the carriage), accompanied by industrial ASMR

  • Military Training (Clicker) - Upgrade Gleb’s bio-chip to resist sedation protocols

Are you ready to press Ctrl+C on your life… without ever pressing Ctrl+V into reality?

Discover the truth in Neo-Uryupinsk.
If CHARL lets you see it.

Language Support

Currently available languages:
English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, LATAM Portuguese, LATAM Spanish

Planned for the full release:
Italian, German, Polish, Ukrainian, French

store_data.about_the_game:
EXILE

Branded expendable by your own government, you are sent into the Interzone, a sealed quarantine where survival is not promised, only expected.

THE INTERZONE

A dark, violent top down open world consumed by collapse, contamination, and unknown anomalies.

  • A fractured territory with shifting dangers

  • Systems have failed, nothing is stable

  • The environment is as deadly as any enemy

COMMUNICATION

The outside world cannot reach you normally.

  • Orders arrive through artillery fired capsules

  • Messages are fragmented and unreliable

  • Tools sent to you are temporary and flawed

SURVIVAL

Everything revolves around staying alive.

  • Manage hunger, thirst, and exhaustion

  • Monitor radiation and contamination levels

  • Limited medical supplies and recovery options

SCAVENGING

Search what remains of a broken world.

  • Loot abandoned buildings and ruins

  • Explore military zones and underground areas

  • Find food, water, ammo, and rare components

CRAFTING

Create what you cannot find.

  • Craft weapons, tools, and survival gear

  • Repair and reinforce equipment

COMBAT

Every fight is a risk.

  • Face infected, survivors, and hostile factions

  • Use melee weapons, firearms, and explosives

  • Ammunition is scarce, every shot matters

ANOMALIES

The world itself is unstable.

  • Deadly environmental hazards

  • Distort space, damage, or kill instantly

  • Some generate rare and valuable artifacts or might teleport you to different areas

WEAPONS

Adapt your loadout to survive.

  • Melee weapons and improvised tools

  • Pistols, rifles, and shotguns

  • Military grade equipment and rare finds

WORLD & BIOMES

A hostile and varied landscape.

  • Contaminated urban ruins

  • Radioactive industrial zones

  • Dead forests warped by anomalies

  • Military exclusion areas

  • Underground networks and tunnels

FACTIONS

You are not alone.

  • Rebel scavengers

  • Military remnants

  • Black market traders

  • Desperate survivors

  • Infected swarms

QUESTS & OBJECTIVES

Nothing is clearly given.

  • Orders delivered through shells

  • Tasks discovered through exploration

  • Clear zones, retrieve items, investigate anomalies

  • Your actions shift the balance

MULTIPLAYER

Survive your way.

  • Play solo or with others

  • Trade, cooperate, or betray

  • Trust is never guaranteed

THE RULE

Nothing stays stable.

  • Areas change over time

  • Safe paths disappear

  • Every decision has consequences

FINAL

The past is gone.
The Interzone remains.

🐓 Fight ridiculous hordes of chickens in a fast, casual arena shooter built for short, chaotic runs. 🐓

Move, dodge, shoot, and survive as wave after wave of angry poultry flood the arena. The controls are simple, the action starts quickly, and every run must last a little longer than the last one!

The game is designed for quick pick-up-and-play sessions: jump in, clear waves, chase a better score, and try not to get overwhelmed by feathers, beaks, and poor life choices.

😮‍💨 Survive the Flock 😮‍💨

The chickens keep coming.

Stay mobile, create space, and react quickly as the arena fills with enemies. Each wave increases the pressure and turns the fight into a messy arcade survival challenge.

🎮 Quick Runs, Fast Restarts 🎮

No long setup. No complicated systems.

Start a run, fight as long as you can, then jump straight back in for another attempt. Ideal for short breaks, Steam Deck sessions, and “one more try” gameplay with Controller-friendly gameplay.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are alone on the road, trying to reach an unknown destination. Cars pass by in the night, and strangers offer you rides. Some are kind. Some are not. Some should never have stopped at all.

Walk through desolate highways, abandoned gas stations, fog-covered forests, and empty roadside towns. Meet bizarre, unpredictable characters who may help you… or make you disappear.

Every decision matters. Every ride is a gamble.

CORE GAMEPLAY

Hitchhike across a branching network of roads and stops

Decide which drivers to trust… or avoid

Engage in tense first-person conversations inside moving vehicles

Observe, investigate, and survive unpredictable situations

React through quick-time events in critical moments

Manage survival needs: hunger, thirst, sleep, hygiene, and stress

A WORLD OF PARANOIA

News reports talk about a series of brutal killings across the region. Radio broadcasts warn travelers to be careful. Posters appear in roadside stops with vague descriptions of a possible suspect.

As tension rises, people become more desperate. Drivers demand payment, favors, or silence. Trust becomes a currency more valuable than money.

And sometimes… you may not be the only one hiding something.

SURVIVAL IS NOT ENOUGH

Talk to drivers
Escape from a moving vehicle
Be stopped by the police and questioned

Walk alone through dangerous routes when no one stops

Decide what kind of person you become

But every action changes the world around you.

WALK BETWEEN WORLDS

Not every journey happens inside a car.

You will walk through:Desolate highwaysAbandoned gas stationsFoggy forestsEmpty roadside structures

Bizarre encounters with strangers who shouldn’t be there

Sometimes, the road itself feels alive.

FEATURES

First-person psychological survival horror

Dynamic hitchhiking system with multiple outcomes

Moral choices with long-term consequences

Resource management and survival mechanics

Reactive world shaped by regional fear and crime reports

Multiple endings depending on your journey

THE ROAD DOESN’T CARE WHO YOU ARE

You are not the driver.
You are not in control.

You are just trying to get a ride.

And the road always collects something in return.

store_data.about_the_game:
CURSOR.EXE is a fast-paced minimalist arcade experience set inside a corrupted digital system.

You are the cursor.

Your goal is to navigate, activate, and deliver signals between nodes while a virus fights you to take complete control. 
Each stage you complete makes the virus more desperate for control. It will begin wasting your time by creating fake nodes, false mission objectives, and find ways to mess with your movement patterns.

The game is focused on short runs with increasing pressure and difficulty rather than long term progression. Mostly designed around reaction speed, movement, and adapting to changing conditions inside the system. 

Can you dominate the virus?

store_data.about_the_game:
"Why should moving a character be as easy as a single click?"

Walking is easy. Sure it is. But is it that easy in this game? If you want to walk, press the 4 keys: [W], [A], [L] and [K]. Exactly those keys. Want to jump? Brace your fingers and press [J], [U], [M] and [P].

You have to jump, air-dash, and dodge lethal spikes to climb your way up. It's quite simple. But it will take some time to get used to.

Moreover, a single missed keystroke could send you plummeting all the way back to the bottom. But hey, you can just climb back up.

Do you have what it takes to master these key chords and reach the top? Yes!

Key Features:

  • The 'Typing Action' Movement System: Execute specific key chords to perform actions. It's not just about timing your jumps; it's about executing the right commands under pressure.

  • Dynamic Vertical World: There is no Game Over. However, you must keep in mind that the higher you climb, the further you can fall from a single mistake.

  • Hardcore Voxel Platformer: Precision is everything. Utilize air-jumps, manage your dash stacks carefully, and avoid the spike traps that will knock you away without mercy.

Controls Overview:

  • Walk: Hold [W] + [A] + [L] + [K]

  • Jump: Press [J] + [U] + [M] + [P]

  • Dash: Hold [D] + [A] + [S] + [H] to charge, release to fire!

  • Menu: Press [M] + [E] + [N] + [U]

  • Exit: SAVE and Exit the game.

(Note: A keyboard with Anti-ghosting / N-Key Rollover supporting at least 4 simultaneous key presses is strictly required to play this game properly!)

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

The Orb has been stolen, trust within the team has collapsed, and Dr. Jim begins a search to uncover who is responsible. The Lakeview Orb 2: Consequences continues directly after the first game, following Dr. Jim as he deals with the fallout of the incident and the uncertainty surrounding the people he once relied on.

Gameplay

This is a short, linear first‑person psychological horror game focused on atmosphere and narrative progression. Players will explore environments connected to Dr. Jim’s search, complete objectives that move the story forward, drive between certain locations as part of the investigation, and watch visual cutscenes that present key moments. The experience is guided, compact, and designed to be completed in a single sitting.

Features

  • Short, linear first‑person narrative experience (less than an hour).

  • Objective‑based progression

  • Driving sections that connect major areas

  • Visual cutscenes that deliver story moments

  • Psychological horror elements and atmospheric tension

  • Direct continuation of the events from The Lakeview Orb

Play Order

This game takes place after the first one. While both games are connected, you can start with either title. The Lakeview Orb 2: Consequences provides enough context for new players, while returning players will recognize it as the next part of the story.

store_data.about_the_game:
Immunity Protocol is a neon pixel-art horde-survival auto-shooter set inside a collapsing biotech system.

Deploy a combat sentinel into a living machine gone hostile. Drift through bloodstream channels, corrupted circuitry, synaptic architecture, and fiber-optic kill zones while swarms, elites, roaming hazards, and recurring boss breaches keep tightening the screen around you. You move. Your arsenal fires automatically. Survival depends on positioning, routing, and building something strong enough to outlast the collapse.

Core Features

  • Manual movement, automatic fire
    Steer through dense enemy pressure while your build handles the shooting.

  • 10 playable sentinel chassis
    Start each run with a distinct weapon, passive identity, and combat style.

  • 6 symbiote companions
    Bring a support organism into battle for tanking, artillery, suppression, shielding, healing, or utility.

  • Build-driven survival runs
    Draft weapons, passives, legends, and run-only augments as the run mutates under pressure.

  • 2 deployment zones, 4 biome identities
    Fight across bloodstream tissue, motherboard corridors, cerebral structures, and fiber-optic lanes with different traversal and encounter reads.

  • Recurring bosses and live hazards
    Survive elite spikes, roaming environmental threats, and biome-routed boss encounters that keep changing the tempo of the run.

  • Persistent laboratory progression
    Archive fragments, secure blueprints, unlock chassis upgrades, expand symbiosis options, and earn achievement bonuses between deployments.

  • Readable neon pixel combat
    High-contrast visuals keep threats, rewards, hazards, and projectiles legible even when the screen turns chaotic.

At Launch Includes

  • 10 playable sentinel chassis

  • 27 weapons

  • 17 passive upgrades

  • 6 symbiote companions

  • 2 deployment zones across 4 biome identities

  • 10 biome-routed bosses

  • 12 achievements with permanent bonuses

Optional AI Windows Hardware Feature
On supported Windows systems, Immunity Protocol can enable optional AI-assisted combat behaviors on verified NPU hardware, including enemy tactics, pressure-direction support, and reward recommendations. This feature is verified-hardware only, is not required to play, and the full game remains fully playable without AI augmentation. The Linux release does not include this optional verified NPU path.

Survive the breach. Rewrite the immune response!

store_data.about_the_game:
The Story of the Soil is in Your Hands!

Beyond the Soil: Farming & Tales Prologue invites you to take the first steps of a peaceful and immersive farming adventure. Far from the chaos, in this valley where it’s just you and nature, you will discover what it means to build a life from scratch and learn the language of the land.

🚜 What Awaits You in This Journey?

  • The Thrill of First Crops: Plow the soil, plant the seeds, and begin mastering the craft of farming by gathering your first harvest.

  • Listen to the Valley Residents: Meet characters like Farmer Jack, help them out, become part of the community, and hear the story of the valley directly from them.

  • Resource Management and Discovery: Chop wood, mine ores, and survive by using the resources around you in the most efficient way.

  • Crafting: Create essential items like fire pits with the materials you collect to develop your living space.

✨ Explore the Mysteries of the Valley!

This beginning opens the doors of the Beyond the Soil world for you. Throughout the Prologue, you will lay the foundations of a deep story, spend time with side activities like fishing, and perhaps find the trail of a loyal friend waiting to be rescued in the heart of nature.

Add Beyond the Soil: Farming & Tales Prologue to your library now and start writing the first page of your own farming legend!

store_data.about_the_game:
You just opened a koshary cart. Simple enough, right?

Wrong. This is Egypt. This is the street. And the street has other plans.

Koshary Chaos is a chaotic street management game set in the heart of Egypt. Take orders, assemble koshary, collect your money and survive everything the neighbourhood decides to throw at you. Because it will throw things. A lot of things. All at once.

The street is alive. Over 20 characters with their own logic, their own agendas, and their own ways of making your life harder or occasionally easier, if you play your cards right. Events unfold the longer you survive. The chaos escalates. Decisions matter.

Some characters can be reasoned with. Some can be avoided. Some will surprise you. And one of them — you'll know him when you meet him — cannot be stopped.

No two rounds play the same. The street is unpredictable, deeply Egyptian, and completely unhinged. But the chaos is universal.

Features:

  • A living open-world Egyptian street with 20+ unique characters

  • Dynamic chaos meter — manage it, or lose everything

  • Random events with modifiers that escalate the longer you survive

  • Missions, unlockables, and level progression

  • Full Arabic and English localization

  • Custom music support — drop your own MP3s and play them on the radio

  • A secret easter egg. You'll find it.

How long can you last before the street wins?

store_data.about_the_game:
FULLY VOICED IN ENGLISH. Every line. Every character. Every scene.

A waitress. An impossible bill. A supper club where the fog rolls in around six and the staff sometimes don't make it home.

Four romance routes. Five stats. One question: how much of the truth are you willing to find?

Fully Voiced in English: Every line of dialogue, every narrator beat, every late-night conversation — performed from first shift to final ending.

Four Romance Routes: A man with old money and older secrets. A regular who watches more than he drinks. A member who knows what's in the walls. A stranger who shouldn't be there at all. Each route reveals a different piece of the room.

Stat-Driven Investigation: Every choice raises one of five stats — Sharp Eye, Nerve, Wit, Trust, Composure — and unlocks or closes scenes, dialogue, and entire branches of the mystery. The men tell you different parts of the truth. You need all four to see the whole picture.

The Pay Is Too Good: The founding families have owned Crestfall Harbor for over a century. The docks. The hospital. The police. And a private supper club that doesn't appear on any public registry.

This is The Server.

It’s a vehicle combat game with randomized loot and PvP objectives. Every round starts from zero.

You build your vehicle during the match, adapting to weapons and upgrades you find along the way. No fixed classes. Your build is your role.

Positioning, timing, and decision-making matter just as much as aim.

Unlock more vehicles, weapons, and upgrades over time and experiment with different builds.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cheese Stack -  is a cozy puzzle game where you arrange falling pieces of cheese into perfect rows. Simple rules, delicious graphics, upbeat music, and a highscore table you'll be tempted to beat. It's the perfect way to relax for 5 minutes or lose yourself in the game for an hour.

How does it work?

Slices of different shapes fall from above. Your task is to rotate them and arrange them to fill horizontal lines. Once you've filled them, the row disappears with a pleasant sound, earning you points. If you don't make it, the stack grows. Everything brilliant is simple.

What makes Cheese Stack special?

🧀 Cheese instead of boring blocks

Each piece is hand-drawn: holes, jagged edges, golden hues. Swiss, Gouda, Cheddar, Parmesan—they're a joy to examine, not just to stack.

🏆 Your Leaderboard

The game remembers your best scores. Beating your own high score is a whole other level of fun. Got friends over? Hand them the controller and see who can do it better.

🎵 Music that stays in your head

Joyful jazz and French tunes that set the rhythm without being overwhelming. You'll find yourself humming them in line at the store.

👶👴 For everyone from 5 to 99 years old

No complex plots, violence, or microtransactions. The rules are explained in 10 seconds. Kids master the controls instantly, and adults appreciate the depth—the further you go, the faster the pieces fall.

store_data.about_the_game:
Clash, push, and burst—
all of our youth lives within this circle.

A group of high school girls devoted to women’s sumo,
living their days through sweat, passion, and determination.

Their intense battles are expressed through a unique twist:
a competitive action game built around “tabletop sumo.”

On the ring, it’s not just technique that collides.
Doubt, admiration, frustration—every emotion is carried in a single strike.

Featuring 6 playable characters,
each with their own story and personal connection to sumo.

Simple controls with deep mind games.
Every moment counts in these tense, fast-paced matches.

■Game Modes

  • Arcade Mode
    Experience each character’s story

  • Local Versus
    Challenge friends in head-to-head matches

  • Online Versus
    Compete with players around the world

■Features

  • A coming-of-age story centered on women’s sumo

  • A unique battle system inspired by tabletop sumo

  • 6 distinct playable characters

  • Easy to pick up, hard to master competitive gameplay

It’s more than just tapping.
Every strike carries everything they are.

store_data.about_the_game:
“Hey, Space Ranger. How’s it going?”

Kemonauts Planet is an old-school dungeon RPG where you sail across the sea of stars.
Create your character with “Kemono Montage” and journey through an infinite, ever-expanding dark universe.

Planets are procedurally generated, along with the people who inhabit them.
Every NPC you encounter can be recruited as a companion—including shopkeepers and even some shady individuals.

Travel across interplanetary routes.
These routes are represented as dungeons, filled with various events and unexpected troubles. Be careful not to run out of food when supplies are contested!

Along your voyage, many different NPCs will stand in your way.
Some wear mysterious masks—who are they really?

Weapons drop randomly, each with a variety of special abilities.
You might even discover your very own glowing lightsaber.

Complete a wide range of missions and earn rewards.
Will you be a bounty hunter, an explorer, or just a debt collector chasing small profits?

When the sun falls, the world changes.

Mid Evil Nights throws you into a dark medieval land where survival is never guaranteed. During the day, you must gather resources, craft equipment, build shelter, and prepare for the dangers ahead. But when night arrives, the creatures of the dark begin to roam, and every wall, weapon, and torch becomes the difference between life and death.

Explore an unforgiving world filled with wilderness, ruins, resources, and secrets. Build a home, turn it into a fortress, and push deeper into the unknown as you uncover the mysteries hiding beneath the surface of this cursed land.

Survive the day. Fear the night. Build your legacy in Mid Evil Nights.

MUGI, originally released in May 2026 as an MSX2-exclusive cartridge, is now on Steam!

Meet MUGI, born in a weapons factory.

An experimental “ego” was installed… and he realized:

“I don’t want to stay in a place like this!”

Avoid the pesky robots!

Set the batteries into the battery boxes!

Escape to the next room through the opened door!

Can you solve the mystery every 5 stages!?

Action & Puzzle!

A fusion of action and puzzle gameplay
Includes mystery-solving elements
Recommended for chiptune fans!

The PC version includes the following additional features:

  • Gorgeous arranged BGM selectable alongside the original MSX2 soundtrack

  • Ranking system (with name entry)

  • Tutorial

  • Stage editor (created stages can be saved as files and shared with friends)

    *We plan to save edited data to the server and share it with people all over the world in a future version update.

  • The instruction manual is included in the same folder as the executable file.

  • Native support for Windows and Linux

  • Linux version tested under Steam Runtime

  • Steam Deck compatibility currently untested

store_data.about_the_game:
Cinematic Business is a deep film-industry management simulator. You run a production studio as both producer and CEO — every screenplay, every casting decision, every release date is yours to make. There are no shortcuts and no "right" answer: you read the talent, you read the market, and you live with the result on opening weekend.

The simulation tracks each creator as a person with a career, not a stat block. Writers grow stronger after every project. Directors form opinions about you. Actors collect filmographies the press will remember. Rival studios run their own pipelines on the same rules you do, with their own strategic profiles, budgets, and ambitions. The industry keeps moving whether you ship a film this year or not.

Develop the Screenplay

Brief your writers on genre, setting, period, themes, tone balance, and role structure. Pick one or two screenwriters from your studio or the open market — their talent, speed, reliability, and genre fit shape what the script becomes. Track the screenplay's idea score, structure, characters, style, logic, worldbuilding, and tone control as it develops. Order corrections, change the writing team mid-project, or shelve the draft if it isn't working.

Assemble the Crew

Run a director kickoff to lock the creative brief, then attach a director by direct pick, shortlist, or open search. Negotiate creative freedom, scenario rights, casting influence, and pace. Cast leads, supporting roles, and minor parts through shortlists, open casting, or director-led picks. Assign a camera operator and lock down shooting locations and stages before the preparation deadline runs out.

Run the Production

Preproduction, shooting, and postproduction each carry their own decisions, costs, and risks. Plan picture editing, sound, music, VFX, and animation work — choose between in-house capacity, outsourced postproduction houses, or premium music options from library tracks to original scores to star composers. Every choice feeds into a ten-category quality score that decides how the film actually plays.

Compete in a Living Industry

AI studios run the full pipeline alongside you, driven by procedural strategic profiles: commercial focus, expansion aggressiveness, producer control, long-term strategy, market reactivity, and financial status. They greenlight projects, hire crews, and release films based on the same world you operate in. The press covers everything — start announcements, reviews, director picks, breakout hits, year-end top lists. Festivals run on a real calendar with nominations, juries, and prestige weights.

Release and Results

Sign distribution contracts, build marketing campaigns with hype tracking across stages, and pick a release date that gives postproduction and marketing room to land. Premiere day converts the entire production chain into reviews, audience numbers, and box office — weekly, by year, and all-time. Strong films collect festival nominations and awards that follow the creators who made them.

Build Your Studio

Expand stages, postproduction rooms, casting offices, and development capacity. Hire permanent writers and production managers, build production teams, and grow your reputation across regions. Decisions you make in year one shape the talent willing to work with you in year ten.

Features

  • Full film pipeline from screenplay brief to box office and festival results

  • Deep creator simulation — writers, directors, actors, operators, and production managers with statistics, careers, and project histories

  • SI rival studios with distinct strategic profiles

  • Press ecosystem with reviews, news coverage, and year-end coverage

  • Festival calendar with nominations, awards, and prestige rules

  • Box office tracking — weekly, yearly, all-time, by region

  • Modular creator sets — the game ships with a default set, with more sets and community-friendly JSON authoring planned

  • Difficulty modes and three career starting points: Startup, Professional, Hollywood

Early Access

Cinematic Business is launching in Early Access. The full pipeline — from screenplay to release, including AI competitors, press, and festivals — is playable today. Early Access is where we tune balance, expand creator content, add scenarios, and shape the simulation around player feedback. See the Early Access section above for details on plans and current state.

store_data.about_the_game:
Soothe is a brief single-player puzzle game characterized by dingey, dystopian architecture and bizarre, abstract imagery. Focus, patience, and attention to detail will serve you well.

You are a lone machine left behind in this strange environment, sporting an extendable grappling claw on your right arm and a melted screen on your left. You will be presented with a series of thematic challenges designed to evoke thoughts of what we value in the lives we all live. The grapple on your right can be used to collect distant objects and interact with the various interfaces you'll need to use to progress through this surreal place. Your only guidance will come from the glass fused into your left hand, and it directs you foremost to do one simple thing - reach the light above. 

Unpack the meaning behind the rooms and find a way to get what you want. That is, after all, more important than anything else. Right?

store_data.about_the_game:
An island. An active volcano. A station to build before it wakes up.

Build, expand, transform

Gather what the terrain offers, order equipment through the Institute's supply chain, assemble your first workbench — then a laboratory, a sensor network, generators, enough to power it all. Each tier unlocks the next. A patch of bare rock becomes, piece by piece, a running facility. And you fund it however you want: science for the Institute, volcanic crops the port can't get enough of, or what a quieter channel takes off your hands through the lava tubes. The station you end up building tells the story of the markets you served.

Read what the volcano is saying

Seismometers, SO₂ sensors, ground deformation readings: each instrument delivers a fragment, none gives the full picture. Cross-referencing the signals, separating pattern from noise — that's what turns a passive station into a system that sees things coming.

Then everything tips

The volcano erupts. Hikers are trapped by the flow. You lift off from your platform and run evacuation rotations — limited capacity, a timer on each group, the lava closing in. Then the front turns back toward your station: hold the line, divert the flow, choose what you save. A few minutes of adrenaline that put everything you've built to the test.

Your call, your consequences

Alert the Institute or wait for more data: nobody decides for you. The reputation you earn in a crisis funds the next one. Rebuild, prepare better — the volcano comes back.

An island. An active volcano. A station to build before it wakes up.

Build, expand, transform

Gather what the terrain offers, order equipment through the Institute's supply chain, assemble your first workbench — then a laboratory, a sensor network, generators, enough to power it all. Each tier unlocks the next. A patch of bare rock becomes, piece by piece, a running facility. And you fund it however you want: science for the Institute, volcanic crops the port can't get enough of, or what a quieter channel takes off your hands through the lava tubes. The station you end up building tells the story of the markets you served.

Read what the volcano is saying

Seismometers, SO₂ sensors, ground deformation readings: each instrument delivers a fragment, none gives the full picture. Cross-referencing the signals, separating pattern from noise — that's what turns a passive station into a system that sees things coming.

Then everything tips

The volcano erupts. Hikers are trapped by the flow. You lift off from your platform and run evacuation rotations — limited capacity, a timer on each group, the lava closing in. Then the front turns back toward your station: hold the line, divert the flow, choose what you save. A few minutes of adrenaline that put everything you've built to the test.

Your call, your consequences

Alert the Institute or wait for more data: nobody decides for you. The reputation you earn in a crisis funds the next one. Rebuild, prepare better — the volcano comes back.
store_data.short_description: Build a scientific station on a remote volcanic island. Fund it through research, farming, or off-the-book channels. Then survive the eruptions: helicopter evacuations, lava flows to hold back, decisions made under pressure. The volcano always comes back.

store_data.about_the_game:
Do you like Boba?

There is no true answer to this age old question. But some say should you choose to find one, the Elevator is the only way there. 

Explore...

Take the Elevator through endless floors seeking a way to reach the top. Be wary of the danger waiting for you as you through each floor. 

Main Features:

  • Online Co-Op: Don't face the dark alone! Bring up to 5 friends to join you on the journey. That's 4 chances that they will be eaten instead of you!

  • Boba: Boba.

  • Suspenseful First-Person Exploration: Navigate claustrophobic, procedurally generated floors where every dark corner could hide the answer you're looking for. Or just a freaky monster. 

  • Terrifying Entities & Jump Scares: You'll definitely want a flashlight when exploring each floor so you don't go head to head with one of the abominations roaming the darkness.

  • Proximity-Based Voice Chat: Keep close to your friends to communicate, because sound doesn't travel far in the oppressive dark.

  • Weapons: Weapons?! Yes, weapons. If you are lucky enough, maybe you'll find firearms left behind by previous pursuers of Boba. They can be of great help to you and your friends as you push upwards. Just be careful, bullets hurt.

Bring Friends. The Journey Is Grim.

Misery loves company. So grab your friends! Up to five fellow Boba Enthusiasts (or just regular friends) can take the plunge with you into the procedurally generated darkness via online co-op. Survival depends on teamwork! Watch each other's backs, turn on a flashlight when the light grows thin, and coordinate your efforts to find a way to the next floor.

When The Elevator Opens, Push Forward.

Do you like Boba? The answer must be found. Travel each floor looking for the exit, or any clues that can take you further toward the answer. (To put it simply: Run, try not to get eaten, find the exit that takes you to the next floor.)

Utility: Find some flashlights and walkie-talkies hidden around each floor. They're a great asset in helping you navigate and communicate with your friends if you get lost or separated.

Weapons: Firearms can provide a major boost to your survivability... or they'll be your demise. Ammo is a rare find and sometimes being loud is the fastest way to meet your end. 

Cowardice Will Be Punished: Those who seek Boba are not afraid. Those who are afraid will suffer. Be wary of your behaviors in game- as people who tend to chicken out are more likely to be tormented...

store_data.about_the_game:
FORGE YOUR PATH

Enter a vast magical world shaped by war, ambition, and shifting allegiances.

In Sellsword, you are not a chosen hero, but a mercenary carving your own path through conflict. Pick your character by choosing from different characters, each offering unique strengths, playstyles, and progression paths.

Whether you prefer close combat, ranged weapons, or a flexible approach, your build defines how you survive and thrive.

A KINGDOM AT WAR

Travel across a large interconnected world map divided between rival kingdoms and competing factions. Each region presents new dangers, opportunities, and contracts.

Seek out work from lords, village leaders, and powerful factions as you move between territories in a land where loyalty is temporary and power must be earned through action.

FIGHT, EXPLORE, SURVIVE

Engage in combat against bandits, creatures, and organized enemy forces. Explore ruins, caves, and contested lands filled with risk and reward.

Grow stronger with each encounter. As your reputation rises, so do the challenges and the rewards that await.

POWER AND INFLUENCE

Choose your allegiances or abandon them when it suits you. Support factions, betray them, or use them to your advantage.

Liberate locations, secure resources, and expand your influence across the realm. The world reacts to your actions, and every decision shapes your future.

YOUR STORY, YOUR LEGACY

Every contract shapes your journey. Every choice carries weight.

In a world of endless conflict, your story is not given. It is forged through ambition, risk, and the path you choose to follow.

KEY FEATURES

  • Pick your character and your overall story will change

  • Define your build through melee and ranged combat styles

  • Explore a large world map with kingdoms, regions, and locations

  • Take contracts from factions, lords, and settlements

  • Fight bandits, creatures, and enemy forces

  • Conquer locations and expand your control

  • Navigate dynamic factions and shifting allegiances

  • Shape your reputation through meaningful choices

  • Experience sandbox freedom with quest driven progression

store_data.about_the_game:
"The recorder lies. The blood lies. And so do you."

Twelve researchers. Nine days. Something is wearing their faces.

Deep Frost is a Carpenter-flavored social-deduction roguelike set on Halström Outpost 7, a failing Antarctic research station where a parasitic intelligence called the Thaw has begun copying its hosts. One by one, the crew is being replaced. You are one of them. Maybe.

Every run, every trait, every relationship is randomized. Every day a new body goes through the airlock. You have until Day 9 to identify the infected, survive the blood test, and hold the station together long enough for the helicopter to return.

Features


  • Full social verb set, chat, ask, plant, defuse, accuse, bribe, specialty, study. Every interaction moves suspicion in a hidden network of 12 contestants.
  • Round-table interrogation, you get questioned too. Lie convincingly or burn.
  • The Thaw sync and queen mechanic, infections spread through contact. The queen rewrites the rules.
  • Anomaly run modifiers — White Noise, Frost Loop, Blood Moon, Recorder Lies. No two runs play the same.
  • Station-ops missions, patch the reactor, hack the airlock, run the blood analysis. Failures cascade.
  • Trait-aware rapport, five relationship tiers per contestant. Treat them right and they'll testify for you. Burn them and they won't.
  • Codex, unlock lore fragments across runs. Halström has lost a crew every eight years. Someone should have told you.
  • Save / continue, day-boundary autosave. The station remembers.

Twelve named contestants. Not random meeples.


KESH won't meet your eye after Day 6. MOIRA's recordings stop matching the timestamps. Dr. Vance's grudge with the surgeon goes back to a paper neither of them will discuss. Every contestant is named, traited, and procedurally pulled into a web of grudges, debts, and quiet loyalties. You learn them. You start to care which ones survive. You vote one out anyway.

Singleplayer. No baggage.


  • No matchmaking queues
  • No microtransactions, no battle pass, no cosmetics store
  • No teenage Discord griefers
  • No cheaters, no smurfs, no "the host left"
  • No scheduling four friends at 2am

The deduction lives in the procedural NPCs. The lies are written, not typed. One purchase, one game, twelve liars, nine days.

Inspirations


If you loved The Thing (1982), Gnosia, or Among Us and wished for a singleplayer horror experience with more teeth, this is that game. Think of it as a single-player Among Us with a story — and a body count that has names attached.

Tone


Paranoid. Cold. Carpenter-flavored. No jump scares. The dread builds in the silences between dialog options, in the way KESH won't meet your eye on Day 6, in the recorder entry that says you were somewhere you weren't, in the blood test on Day 4 when the centrifuge hums and nobody blinks.

Solo dev


Deep Frost is built and released by AeonGames. Audio sourced under Creative Commons from OpenGameArt and Pixabay (full credits in-game). Visual art AI-assisted. Written, coded, designed, and tested by one person over a year.

Controls


  • WASD / Arrow keys, move
  • E / Space, interact
  • F1, mechanics briefing
  • Esc, pause

Manage units

store_data.about_the_game: STARSHIP BLOOPERS is a chaotic co-op space survival game where one wrong move can doom the mission. Play with 2 to 6 crewmates as you traverse space, gather resources, survive disasters, battle aliens and each other's incompetence before the sun goes supernova. Can you keep your SHIP together?
store_data.detailed_description:
WORK TOGETHER (GOOD LUCK WITH THAT)

All Hands on Deck? You'll need to rely on your crewmates if you want any hope of making it through space alive, not that they'll be much help. Repair damaged systems, respond to emergencies and work together to stop small problems from becoming full ship-wide disasters.


EXPLORE SPACE (WHAT COULD POSSIBLY GO WRONG?)

Chart your course through space, explore dangerous locations and alien hazards you probably weren't ready for. Gather the resources you need to keep your ship running and escape the solar system before time runs out and the sun goes supernova.


SURVIVE (SKILL ISSUE)

Space doesn’t care about you! Aliens, fires, broken systems, and disasters you definitely didn't plan for can strike at any moment. Think fast, adapt to the chaos and try to hold it together long enough to finish the mission.


KEEP YOUR SHIP TOGETHER! (OR DON'T, SEE WHAT HAPPENS)

Your ship is your only lifeline. Without it you're just floating in space, which is not ideal. Keep it repaired, keep your crew alive and hold everything together long enough to make it out in one piece.


EVERY RUN IS DIFFERENT (FRESH CHAOS EVERY TIME)

Sector-based runs mean every jump brings new risks, resources and decisions. No two missions play out the same way, so whatever worked last time probably won't save you now.


RANK UP (GATEKEPT BY YOUR OWN INCOMPETENCE)

Take on crew roles, earn upgrades, unlock new abilities and climb the ranks. Survive long enough and you might even look like you know what you're doing.


KEY FEATURES (NO CAP)

  • 2–6 player online co-op aboard a failing starship

  • Space survival action with repairs, combat, crafting, scavenging and exploration

  • Dynamic ship emergencies including fires, hull breaches, oxygen loss, rogue AI and system failures

  • Alien threats and infestations that force the crew to respond fast or lose control

  • Sector-based runs where each jump brings new risks, resources and decisions

  • Crew roles and progression with upgrades, rank, unlocks and status rewards

  • High replayability driven by unpredictable disasters and crew-driven chaos

  • CROWDPLAY features planned for streamer and spectator interaction

  • Big dumb fun with enough pressure to matter and enough stupidity to make failure worth it!


DESIGNED FOR STREAMS, CLIPS AND CROWDPLAY (WATCH THIS SPACE)

Some games are fun to play. Some are fun to watch.

STARSHIP BLOOPERS is being built for both.

With Crowdplay features planned from the start, spectators will be able to influence the chaos and help turn every mission into a live, interactive disaster show.

Your viewers might save you. Your viewers might doom you. Either way, they’ll be part of the story.

More coming soon...


WORK IN PROGRESS

Please note that STARSHIP BLOOPERS is currently in early pre-production. All assets/visuals are work-in-progress and subject to change.

>>> WELCOME TO PROJECT B.L.U.E.

B.L.U.E. [Build, Launch, Upgrade, Evolve] is an simulation software designed by BlueHeaven Aerospace Corporation for training our engineers in space exploration, ship design and combat. It involves realistic simulations of both space physics and current technologies within the BlueHeaven product lineups. Your mission as the B.L.U.E. engineer is to Build the best ships, Fight other candidates, Improve your designs and Evolve your skills!

NOTICE: THE CURRENT STATE OF B.L.U.E. IS ONLY FOR CONCEPT VALIDATION, IT IS NOT NOT NOT A FULL GAME, EXPECT POTENTIAL BUGS AND PERFORMANCE ISSUES!

>>> SHIP BUILDING SYSTEM

Every spaceship in B.L.U.E. is player designed. We have a list of modular components for propulsion, radiation, combat, structure, defense, etc. Choose the parts for your dreadnought, snippers, interceptors or destroyers, and beat your friends or opponents in a way they never thought off!

Also, remember to be Cost Efficient! BlueHeaven Aerospace awards employees with designs that minimizes our cost in missions.

>>> PHYSICS AWARE SHIP PERFORMANCE

The maneuverbility and performace of your ship is entirely dependent on your design! B.L.U.E. uses a serious of physics simulations to compute mass, thrust and moment of inertia or your ship. If you cannot move or turn, there are some engines or RCS you forgot to add!

>>> HEAT AND RADIATION

How comes every space movie forget about HEAT! Every part on your ship generates heat, and we have an full heat conduction simulator. If you don't build these radiators to get rid of the heat you are gonna burn bright hot!

>>> Fight! Fight! Fight!

Finally its time to Test your design! hop into or start a server, call up your friends, and fight with your ship! Testing is the only way to validate and improve stuff in Aerospace, so embark and enjoy!

The gold rush has transformed the quiet frontier town of Leadville into a battleground for greed and justice. When a gang of bandits ambushes a silver carriage bound for the bank, a deadly showdown ensues. Will the sheriff’s posse manage to protect the valuable shipment, or will the outlaws make off with the loot?

Leadville is a grid-based hidden movement strategy game. Each turn, players secretly plan the movement and shot direction of their crew, trying tooutmaneuver their rivals. The map is filled with obstacles and boons: covers, aids, and traps, and the ever-moving gold wagon that may decide the game’s finale.

In the Wild West, there are no second chances: only those with quick thinking and a steady aim prevail. Choose which side of the law you're on.

Leadville is a board game adaptation of the upcoming same-named board game by Ramezware.

store_data.about_the_game:
Day one: a coal mine, an iron mine, a well, a farm. That's it. Earth is modern but empty of space infrastructure, and the only way forward is to build it yourself.

Mine coal to make power. Smelt iron into steel. Refine oil into rocket fuel. Process air into oxygen and nitrogen. Grow the supply chain until you've got electronics, composites, and a rocket assembly plant. Then you launch.

Low orbit is a station, not a home — a staging point you use to reach the Moon. The Moon has polar ice and regolith and no atmosphere. Mars has thin air full of CO2 and enough water locked in the ground to run a Sabatier reactor and brew your own methane. Each world is a new economy you have to rebuild for the environment you're in.

Transport ties it all together. Ships run fixed loops between worlds — Earth to orbit to the Moon, Earth to Mars, Moon to Mars — hauling whatever cargo you tell them to haul. You pick the stops. You pick the cargo. You scale the fleet. A single screen shows every line in your network at a glance, green where it's flowing and red where it's stalled.

No lose state. Close the game for a week and your colonies are still there, making things, waiting.

Key Features

The gameplay is logistics, production, and network-building — not piloting or physics. The systems below are what ships today.

  • A production chain built on real recipes: Rockets burn RP-1 kerosene refined from crude oil. Mars methane comes out of a Sabatier reactor fed by local CO2 and hydrogen split from water ice. Steel is iron ore cooked in a smelter. Nothing is magic. Everything is a recipe.

  • Four worlds, four economies: Earth, low orbit, the Moon, and Mars. Each has its own buildings, its own resources, and its own production problems to solve. You don't pilot ships or manage orbits — you build the supply chain that keeps each world fed.

  • Transport is the game: Ships run fixed loops between worlds. Pick the stops, pick the cargo, scale the fleet. Watch the whole network on a single screen and catch the one line that just stalled.

  • A tech tree you can follow: Power Systems. Atmospheric Processing. Fuel Chemistry. Rocket Engineering. Orbital Operations. Lunar Exploration. Mars Transit. Every tech unlocks a building you can actually build.

  • Population that you have to keep alive: Colonies need habitats, food, water, and oxygen. People are your workforce, and losing the supply chain that supports them doesn't kill them — it just stops everything from working. Managing that tension is half the game.

  • Offline progress that respects your time: Close the tab. Close it for a week. The game keeps ticking. Come back to stockpiles and a running economy.

  • Ranks to chase: Tiered achievements on every resource and building, feeding a 20-rank ladder from Ground Crew to Stellar Vanguard.

  • Built for long play: Auto-save every 30 seconds. Export and import your save. An example save for exploring a mid-game state. Four theme presets plus full color customization. A curated soundtrack. A desktop client with a clean borderless window and updates that land without asking.

Relaxing Zen or Total Chaos. You Choose!

Welcome to the ultimate physics playground where the only limit is your imagination. Whether you want to build a hypnotic, ASMR-style loop or a massive, logic-defying mechanical beast, Crafty Marbles gives you the tool you need!

🛠️ Build Anything, Break Everything

Lay down miles of track in seconds or spend hours tweaking every angle and speed to perfection.

  • Snap & Go: Connect tons of modules instantly with intuitive, click-to-snap building.

  • Complex Contraptions: Integrate spinning hammers, smashing rackets, and gravity-defying obstacles.

  • Deep Logic: Combine sensors, triggers, and mechanical parts to create fully automated marvels.

🏁 The Greatest Spectacle

Your marbles aren’t just props, they’re the stars of the show. Give them names, skin them with unique textures, and pit them against each other in high-stakes races.

  • Emergent Drama: Watch marbles collide, recover, and battle for the lead through branching paths and hidden shortcuts.

  • The Trap Factor: Will you build a fair race, or a gauntlet of doom filled with blockers and giant swinging clubs?

  • Cinematic Chaos: Switch to the follow-cam and experience your creation from the marble's perspective.

🎨 A Living, Breathing Toy Box

store_data.about_the_game:
A town. A stairway. A lot of missing adventurers.

Many years ago, in the middle of Desolation, someone found a stairway leading down into a huge labyrinth. Since then, adventurers from across the Seven Kingdoms have come looking for fame, fortune, and powerful artifacts.

A few return rich.  Most do not return at all.

Dungeons of Desolation Remastered brings back the Xbox Live Indie Games dungeon crawler from 2012: turn-based, grid-based, loot-heavy, and built around the dangerous idea that you can probably survive one more floor.

Descend into 25+ dungeon levels filled with procedural layouts, dozens of monsters, and more than 150 items to find, equip, drink, sell, or regret picking up. No two trips below Desolation are quite the same.

Build your adventurer through stats, gear, and over 100 skills. Fight with swords, axes, maces, daggers, shields, or magic. Focus on combat, detection, healing, protection, enchantment, or whatever build keeps you alive long enough to reach the next staircase.

Then return to town.  Talk to the townsfolk, they might help you out, for a price...

In Desolation death is not always the end, but it is never free. When you fall in the dungeon, the Wheel of Fate decides what you lose before your next attempt. Gold. Experience. Items. Progress. Maybe something worse.

Features

  • Turn-based, grid-based dungeon crawling

  • 25+ dungeon levels to explore

  • Procedural floors that change every descent

  • Randomized items and loot drops, so no two playthroughs are the same

  • 150+ items, weapons, armour pieces, potions, and gear

  • 100+ skills across combat, magic, defence, detection, healing, and more

  • Dozens of monsters lurking below town

  • Town hub for shopping, recovery, and preparation

  • Die? Play a game of fate with Death. You might get lucky...

  • Feeling confident? Play Hardcore Mode with enhanced difficulty and permadeath, but with extra XP, loot, and gold

  • Remastered from the Xbox Live Indie Games era

Can you discover the secrets lurking in the deepest depths?

store_data.about_the_game:
In Hide or Seek: Container Island, you can play as a hider or seeker. While playing as a hider (SOLO, COOP, PVP), you have to hide from seekers until you get picked up to be dropped off in another area. You must be at the Pick Up zone at the end! You have to go through multiple areas to finally escape Container Island. Look for magic potions hidden mostly inside containers to help you escape but watch out for unexpected creatures and traps!

As a seeker (PVP only), your mission is to stop all hiders from escaping Container Island. You can also use some of the magic potions, but you also may have to deal with those creatures. Teamwork is crucial to find and capture the hiders.

MAGIC POTIONS

Magic potions take hiding and seeking to a whole new level. Potions can make a hider or seeker run faster, become invisible or heal faster.  Certain potions can be used only certain hiders and certain seekers. In coop or pvp, collect potions for others on your team to help them survive. 

2 CLASSES, MANY CHARACTERS

The hider class, NegoNego cats, has over 10 characters to choose from. Each character can initially use only a certain set of magic potions and can upgrade to more potions after having earned rewards.

The seeker class, Dhug dogs, also has more than 10 characters to choose from and can be upgraded to use more options, abilities, custom outfits, and accessories after having earned rewards.

New characters will be introduced frequently.

UNPREDICTABLE MAPS

You will have to escape from several randomly picked maps from more than 30 maps. Every time you play, each map will have different creatures and traps. No matter how many times you play, you will have a completely different experience. New maps and creatures will be introduced frequently. 

CREATURES and TRAPS

Expect the unexpected. These creatures and traps will make both hiding and seeking more challenging. Some creatures and traps may only affect hiders or seekers or both. Some potions may protect hiders and seekers from some creatures and traps and some may not.


SOLO, COOP OR PVP

As solo hider, you will have to deal with numerous AI seeker dogs chasing after you. You will have to heavily rely on magic potions you find. As COOP hiders, you should rely on each other to find potions for each other and also distract seekers from a hider about to get captured.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rediscover a Lost Civilization

A millennia ago, the Rune Civilization carved the laws of the world into these stones. Now, they slumber in eternal darkness. You will step into the shoes of a silent archaeologist venturing deep into these subterranean caverns. There is no complex combat here—only the mysterious resonance emanating from ancient stone arrays. Your mission is to awaken these long-dormant runes.

Rune Resonance

Experience a sophisticated dual-layer matching system:

The Rune Altar: The altar is stacked with ancient rune stones in intricate patterns. Every puzzle is a test of spatial hierarchy and logical sequencing.

The Guardian Echoes: Translucent spiritual echoes float throughout the cave, constantly bouncing and moving to obstruct the altar runes below. You must track and match these moving targets in real-time to clear a path to the stones beneath them.

Dynamic Hazards and Variations

The deeper you go, the more the cave resists your presence. As your exploration intensifies, the ancient restrictions within the caverns grow increasingly strange and volatile.

Guaranteed Solvability

Every floor is 100% solvable through logic and strategy. Every altar ensures a definitive path to victory. Failure is never a matter of luck, but a result of the choices you make when faced with multiple paths and complex decisions.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE ORDER OF THE DAMNED is a dark-fantasy action-RPG from the shadows of Arthurian legend.

As Duran, one of the last remnants of a fallen Order of knights, you must choose your path as you fight to uncover the mystery of the Spectre that haunts you and destroy the ancient darkness of The Revenant. Steel your abilities as a warrior, master the mysteries of the arcane or hone your many talents as you develop your character through a branching skill tree. There are many souls, friend and foe, to encounter on your journey through the wasteland. Many decisions you must face. The choices you make matter and will shape your ultimate fate - and that of your world.

Discover the faded ruins and lost legends of a mythical post-Roman Britain. In the deepest shadows of haunted forests, through the frozen wilderness of barren mountains, to the ancient stones that stand older than time itself, explore a broken world shrouded in darkness and mystery as you search for what remnants are whispered to survive. 


 

The battle is yours. Cut down your enemies in furious real-time combat or learn to harness the Spectre that haunts you to unleash lethal devastation. Hone your skills in various weaponry and chain deadly attack moves as you forge a bloody path through the forces that assail you. 

The Order Of The Damned is a darkly atmospheric RPG with old-school DNA. With unforgiving action, a deep, challenging narrative and a haunted world to discover, forge your path in a land of legend where duty and destiny collide.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Follow Alice into the abyss."

Project Rabbit is an Extraction Soulslike Action RPG inspired by a dark fantasy reimagining of Alice in Wonderland.

Fight, explore, and survive within the twisted abyss of time. Will you escape the madness, or be consumed by it?

[Into the Abyss of Time]

When the power of dimensions collapsed, continents from different realms became entangled into a single world, and within the cracks between them, the “Abyss of Time” was born.

The Abyss is a twisted world sealed away by the Blood Queen.

Within it wander beings that neither age nor die, trapped in an endless cycle of time.

Those who survived the darkness of the Abyss built the last refuge beneath a fading barrier of light.

But the barrier is slowly losing its power.

To survive, someone must once again step into the Abyss.

Will you survive the madness consuming the Abyss of Time alongside Alice?

[Forge Your Own Way to Fight the Madness]

Within the Abyss of Time, even the smallest mistake can lead to a fatal end.

Use dodges, parries, and a variety of combat skills to battle against beings consumed by madness.

Discover hidden treasures and forgotten secrets buried deep within the Abyss, and forge your own combat style through countless combinations of weapons, equipment, and skills.

[Explore the Abyss Together — And Return Alive]

Venture into the dangerous Abyss of Time alone, or alongside your allies.

Within the Abyss, it is not only creatures consumed by madness that await you, but also unpredictable encounters with other survivors.

If you manage to claim valuable treasures and resources, you must survive and make it back alive before losing everything.
