Tenebrix (Early Access)

Descend into Tenebrix, a dark fantasy roguelite where deckbuilding, dungeon crawling, and camp progression collide. Choose one of four classes, build a deck of creatures, sorceries, and enchantments, then fight for control of a three-lane battlefield where position matters as much as power.

Between battles, explore procedural dungeon floors filled with traps, roaming monsters, treasure chests, secret doors, fear, corruption, and hard choices about whether to push deeper or return to camp. store_data.about_the_game:
A Tiny Desk Companion

Let a leopard gecko quietly move onto your desktop. It will wander, pause, and rest in the corner of your screen like a tiny living presence that never gets in your way. When you want to check in, step into its vivarium, refill its water, feed it, and tidy up its little world.

Build Its Vivarium by Hand

From hides, water bowls, and basking spots to lighting, create a comfortable habitat for your gecko. Different objects change both the function and atmosphere of the vivarium, shaping the everyday moments you will notice next.

Observe Its Daily Habits

Your gecko will not always move on your schedule. It may rest, roam, find a place to hide, approach water, or respond when the timing is right. Watch for a few seconds, record what you see, and slowly learn the rhythm of its life.

A Real Little Environment on Your Desktop

Heat lamps, water bowls, hides, and substrate all affect the temperature inside the vivarium. Open the temperature view to see how the basking spot, cool zone, hides, and water area change across the enclosure.

Unlock Different Morphs

As your observation level increases, new morph skins will gradually become available. From classic natural looks to brighter selectively bred varieties, give your gecko a new appearance and see which one feels most at home on your desktop.

store_data.about_the_game:
An infinitely expanding 2D Psychological Horror clicker game with hundreds of secrets and puzzles to solve and explore. There is always more to see.

Work through the game's infinitely progressing storyline uncovering the secrets and scares hidden in the deep environmental story-telling.

You are tasked with destroying an ancient artifact all while fending off the entities it attracts and uncovering the meaning behind it all before it's too late.

Beat the game? Great!

With the infinitely expanding storyline in the 'chapter select' structure of the game, you can keep playing with new game mechanics, new lore to uncover, to horrifying monsters to see, and so much more.

Beat all the current content? That's fine.

With the implementation of multiple save files, you are encouraged to replay the game and see all the things you may have missed the first time around.

Important

The Discord server linked on the Steam Store page of the game is where indepth patch notes and development updates will be recorded. Please consider joining if you want to hear about and become a part of the development of the game.

The Discord server is not just a place for the game's community, it is a tool the players can use to enhance their experience while playing. Player's who join the discord have the opportunity to shape the game's future development and become immortalised in the game's credits forever just for making a suggestion.

So i urge you to please join our Discord community if you want to become a apart of something bigger.

This game is made by a solo developer, (me), and I am putting all of my effort and passion into this project, I will listen to every single bit of feedback given both on Steam and in the game's official Discord you can find on the store page.

Be a part of the game's development, let me know what you want to see.

store_data.about_the_game:
《Fluff Up》is a charming yet brutally precise platformer starring a bird who's carrying a few extra ounces. Your

mission: flap, climb, and drag that chunky little body into the sky. It's equal parts delightful and punishing.

GAMEPLAY

The controls couldn't be simpler — hold left or right and your bird flies in that direction. But flying burns stamina

fast, and if you run out before you reach the next cloud, gravity does what gravity does. Plan every move. You're not

exactly aerodynamic.

FEATURES

Easy to learn, hard to stop failing at. This bird is heavy — the physics won't let you forget it. Mid-air turns are

sluggish, stamina is never quite enough, and every flight demands a split-second plan before you commit. There's no

winging it.

Land soft, or fall straight through. Obviously. Clouds are fluffy; your bird is not. Control your descent or you'll

regret it.

Clouds are your friends — most of them, anyway. Every cloud type has its own personality. Learn their patterns, figure

out who helps and who betrays, and you'll climb faster. Or just blame the clouds. Up to you.

A slip isn't the end. If you tumble off a cloud, don't panic — you can still recover. Use whatever's below you to

cushion the fall, scramble for another perch, and claw your way back. Whether you bounce back or plummet to the bottom

depends entirely on your hands.

EXPERIENCE

Cheerful pixel art brings this whimsical world to life, while the tough-as-nails gameplay keeps you coming back for

one more try. The moment you finally break through the highest layer of clouds? Worth every fall.

But success can wait. If you're exhausted, just land on a cloud and rest for a bit. There's no game over here —

falling only means you start climbing again. Take your time. The sky isn't going anywhere.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Vlog

"Likes, Comments, and... Nightmares."

The Vlog is a first-person comedy horror game where you play as an aspiring livestreamer willing to do anything for views.

After hearing rumors about a strange abandoned building hidden outside the city, you decide to start a late-night livestream and explore it for content. What begins as a stupid internet challenge quickly turns into something far more disturbing, awkward, and unexpectedly hilarious.

Armed with your camera, livestream setup, and an audience that cares more about entertainment than your safety, you enter the building in search of viral moments. Your viewers constantly spam the chat with reactions, jokes, terrible advice, and ridiculous challenges that push you deeper into the unknown.

Eat something suspicious?
Turn off the lights?
Knock on a creepy door?
Investigate the strange noise upstairs?

For the viewers, it's content.
For you, it might be a terrible idea.

As you explore the building floor by floor, you'll encounter bizarre paranormal events, strange creatures, unsettling puzzles, and absurd situations that blur the line between horror and comedy. While your audience laughs, clips moments, and demands more chaos, something inside the building seems to be watching the stream with you.

Your goal is simple: reach the top floor and uncover the truth behind the mysterious light shining from the window above.

Gameplay

The Vlog combines atmospheric horror, exploration, puzzle-solving, and livestream-style interaction into a unique single-player experience.

The game is presented entirely through the perspective of a streamer, complete with a facecam-style layout and a constantly active live chat that reacts dynamically to what you do. The chat acts as both comic relief and gameplay guidance, sometimes helping you solve puzzles while also encouraging the worst possible decisions imaginable.

Players will:

  • Explore a mysterious abandoned building

  • Complete bizarre livestream challenges from viewers

  • Solve environmental puzzles

  • Experience comedic and paranormal events

  • Interact with a reactive livestream chat

  • Discover hidden areas and strange encounters

  • Progress through increasingly unsettling floors

  • Survive the consequences of chasing online fame

Features

  • First-person comedy horror experience

  • Immersive streamer-style presentation

  • Live chat system with viewer interactions and challenges

  • Atmospheric abandoned building exploration

  • Puzzle-solving gameplay

  • Mix of psychological horror and absurd comedy

  • Strange paranormal encounters and unexpected events

  • Short single-player experience focused on immersion and entertainment

  • Dynamic sound design inspired by livestream culture

In The Vlog, your viewers want one thing:

Good content.

No matter what happens to you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Crowned Games is an online party game platform for groups of 2–12 players.

One host, one lobby, many minigames — play them all in a single session.

YOUR CONTENT, YOUR RULES

Every game that uses player-provided content draws from your own packs.

Build a pack with photos from your friend group, inside jokes as words,

or custom audio clips — the games become personal.

Packs support four asset types:

• Images — use your own photos or downloaded art

• Audio — voice clips, sound effects, music snippets

• Words — custom word lists for drawing or clue games

• Prompts — custom questions and scenarios

📝 QUIZ EDITOR

Build your own trivia rounds from scratch. Write questions, set answer options,

mark the correct one. Import them as a pack and challenge your friends with

questions only they (or only you) would know.

🎮 THE GAMES

IMPOSTOR — Social deduction

Everyone gets the same secret word — except the Impostor. Give clues that prove

you know it without giving it away. Vote out the Impostor before they blend in.

STINKY CROWN — Voting

Each round, a prompt appears. Vote for who in the group fits it best.

The most-voted player earns the Stinky Crown. It stacks.

FRAMEUP — Bluffing

You get an image. Describe it to the group — but you choose whether to describe

yours truthfully or invent a lie about someone else's. The group votes: truth or lie?

MIRAGE — Hint & match

One player writes a hint for their image. Everyone else picks the image from their

own hand that best matches that hint. The group then votes for the original.

Hints that are too obvious or too cryptic lose points — balance is everything.

DOODLE KINGS — Draw & guess

Pick a secret word and draw it. Other players race to type the answer first.

Speed pays more than accuracy — fastest correct guess earns the most points.

QUIZ DUEL — Trivia

A question appears. First to buzz in gets to answer. Right answers earn points,

wrong answers give the lead to someone else. Use your own quiz packs or the defaults.

FEATURES

✓ Multiple minigames in one lobby — mix and match in any order

✓ 2–12 players online

✓ Custom image, audio, word, and prompt packs

✓ Built-in Quiz Editor — write your own trivia rounds

✓ Running score across all games in a session

store_data.about_the_game:
Inertia 2: Definitive Edition is the next chapter from the creator of Inertia - a first-person platformer built entirely around fluid, refined movement mechanics.

Nine years on, the foundation that made Inertia resonate with players is back - smoother, deeper, and complete from day one.

Move. Inertia 2: Definitive Edition is built on a refined and evolved movement system - wall-runs, platforming, and fluid traversal that rewards mastery without punishing newcomers. Whether you're here to play casually or chase world records, the movement adapts to your playstyle.

Create. Build your own levels with a full in-game level creator. Place every element and geometry feature found in the official levels - jump pads, wall-runs, elevators, rising platforms, horizontal movement platforms, and material-editable geometry across a curated set of surfaces. No external tools, no complexity - just build and play.

Compete. Steam Leaderboards with anti-cheat measures put your times on the board from day one. Every official level; every community level - compete, compare, and chase the top spot. The speedrun community has a home here from launch.

Workshop. Share your levels with the world through full Steam Workshop integration. Browse, subscribe, and play community-created levels without leaving the game. The Workshop is live from Early Access - meaning the community is already building by the time 1.0 arrives.

The Definitive Edition difference. The original Inertia earned its community over time - Workshop support, leaderboards, and the level creator all arrived at 1.0. Inertia 2: Definitive Edition launches with all of it. Every feature, from day one.

store_data.about_the_game:
A haveli frozen since 1985. No one who enters ever leaves. Dare to face the darkness of an abandoned Indian heritage haveli — where Pichhal Peri hunts you through every shadow, every corridor, every room.

───────────────────────────────── DO YOU DARE ───────────────────────────────── This is Indian horror. This is the horror your grandparents warned you about. The horror that lives in the stories told after dark. The horror that is woven into the soil of this land. If you dare to walk through the dark corridors of an abandoned heritage haveli — if you dare to hold your fear and keep moving — Pichhal Peri is waiting for you. She has been waiting since 1985.

YOUR VOICE IS YOUR ONLY WEAPON

You cannot fight Pichhal Peri. You cannot run forever. When she is close — when you can hear her coming — there is only one thing that can stop her. Speak. Into your real microphone. The mantras you need find inside the haveli. The words that have protected this land for thousands of years. Speak them aloud and she will retreat. Stay silent and she will reach you.

This game contains truly unpredictable jump scares, complete darkness, and a ghost that does not follow rules. If you scare easily — this game is for you anyway. But you have been warned.

ABOUT XOOGAMES

XooGames is an independent studio from Delhi, India dedicated to bringing authentic Indian folklore and culture to gaming. Pichhal Peri is our first game — a horror experience rooted in real North Indian legend, built with love for Indian heritage and storytelling.

Turn eternal punishment into your personal playground as you design devious systems, experiment with trap combinations, and trap the world’s most persistent worker in an infinite loop of failure.

Blending Greek myth with the absurdity of a 21st-century office grind, the game delivers a darkly comedic take on productivity, repetition, and the meaninglessness of… well, endlessly pushing that boulder.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ironfields is a single-player RTS about capturing the battlefield, not building a base from scratch.

Each mission starts with key structures already placed across the map. You capture them, repair them, defend them, build towers around them, upgrade your units, and decide when it is finally safe to push forward.

The pace is slower and more tactical than a typical click-heavy RTS. You are not meant to win by fast reflexes. You win by holding the right positions, surviving constant pressure, and using the tools each mission gives you.

Capture key buildings
You do not build a traditional base. Instead, you fight for factories, power plants, satellites, and other strategic structures already placed on the battlefield. Every building you secure changes the balance of the mission.

Survive constant enemy pressure
The enemy does not wait for clean scripted waves. It keeps sending units, forcing you to defend, repair, reposition, and slowly turn the map in your favor.

Use airstrikes and towers to break stalemates
Some defenses cannot be pushed through by tanks alone. Build towers, upgrade your units, and call in airstrikes when you need to destroy a key target or open a path forward.

Ironfields focuses on tactical decisions, map control, and hand-crafted single-player missions inspired by older RTS games.

Features

  • Single-player RTS focused on planning and positioning

  • No traditional base building

  • Capture, repair, and defend battlefield structures

  • Build towers and upgrade your units

  • Call in airstrikes to support your attacks

  • Slower-paced tactical gameplay

  • Hand-crafted missions with strong map-control focus

  • Built-in layout editor for custom combat layouts

store_data.about_the_game:
Your grandmother left her cabin to you.

She left a basket by the door, a field guide to document what you'd find, and ten villagers who still expect her tinctures on a regular basis. She left a hearth grown cold, a library behind the wall, and an attic full of thoughts she never got to share. Most importantly, she left you the woods.

Forage the forest she walked.

Eight biomes each with its own season-by-season cast of 38 mushroom species drawn from real foraging traditions (and a handful that aren't quite real). Spring chanterelles. Summer chicken of the woods. Autumn porcini. Winter velvet shanks. Even dangerous lookalikes mimicking the safe varieties. Find them all. Identify what you can with the Field Guide and have Fern help you with the ones you can't. Catalog everything in Grandma's Field Guide: the pages that fill in, one species at a time, as you explore the world she left behind.

Brew the recipes she perfected.

96 tinctures built from four preparation techniques: cold infusion, alcohol distillation, fermentation, and hot water decoction. Each method draws out different properties of the same mushroom. Every recipe was hers first, written in margin notes and half-remembered conversations. You'll find them all in time: some by reading, some by listening

to villagers who knew her.

Restore what she loved.

The hearth, the cellar, the library, the attic, the greenhouse: all hers, all closed up the day she stopped being able to manage them alone. Restoring each one opens a piece of who she was. Each brings a new system: storage, illustration, cultivation and less spoilage.

Tend who she took care of.

Ten villagers, each with their own stories, their own requests, and their own memories of your grandmother. Bram at the inn carries a grief he speaks of sideways. Aldric needs help with his fields. Elara studies the stars and asks for things grandma would have known to bring. Build relationships with each of them one heart at a time. Bring what they need. Listen when they're ready to tell you why.

Hear what she heard.

The Wood Wide Web is real. Eight Mother Trees scattered across the woods remember her, and remember things she never wrote down. Bring them tribute and they'll speak. Bring them enough and they'll grant you a Golden Mushroom: six in all, scattered across the biomes she walked. Find all six and who knows where you'll end up.

What this game is:

A game you can play for an evening or for a season. A cabin you'll come home to. Letters that arrive at the right time. A grandmother who shows up everywhere: in the recipes, the mushrooms, even the way the villagers say your name.

Slow days. Quiet evenings. Nothing chasing you.

---

*Under the Elm is a solo project from Crooked Stone Studios made by Christina Shackford with care, slowness, and a deep love for the woods.

store_data.about_the_game:
Trade your lives for POWER. Fight against your friends with endless character customization possibilities and rollback netcode.

All 9 Lives is a small indie fighting game, playable on web browsers for free. The Steam version has a few exclusive benefits:

  • Faster load times

  • Playable without an internet connection

  • Bonus stages

  • Arcade mode with unique character endings

  • Practice mode with advanced features

  • Exclusive "Steam Supporter" tag for to use online

  • Development support for additional features and content.

You were born with 9 lives, but during battle you have the ability to trade each life for a unique power. The more powers you have, the less lives you get.

Guns deal a LOT of damage... but trading a life for a bulletproof vest will help. A vest may help, but your opponent might choose faster reloads for when your protection is gone. What will you do next? 

The loser gets to edit their loadout after each round. To win you must think carefully and adapt to any situation.

  • Experience the merge between traditional 2D Fighting games with Beat 'em up style moves.

  • Play your way with customizable loadouts, building your favorite fighting game archetype.

  • All 9 Lives features full online fighting with rollback netcode. Invite friends to play or fight alone in single player modes.

  • Full Keyboard & Controller Support (with custom input configurations).

All 9 Lives was built with community features to stand the test of time. You can upload match footage, extreme combos, or tips and tricks for other players to learn from. The community has one place to share, improve, and push the game further together.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Worlda!

Worlda is a 2D top down pixel-art sandbox adventure where you play as grizzly bear cub Jonas as he sets forth into a large, infinite world.  Will you make it through the night, or will you bear-ly survive? 

Be a builder-bear. Be a better builder-bear. Keep building. Keep gathering food. And watch out for those bees! You will need some torches or the nights will become un-bear-able. Always keep a pawful of berries for travelling, no matter bear you go! Well, have a beary good adventure!

Bear with me as we go through some key features:

  • Charming pixel art graphics!

  • Sandbox world.

  • Explore an infinitely generated world with different environments such as snow, grass and desert!

  • Craft a wide selection of tools, walls, and objects to survive.

  • Hunt animals for food or collect wild berries.

  • Skate on the ice and build ice-skating rinks!

  • Fight with the Zom-Bees, evil bees which only come out at night!

  • Meet other bears

  • Fish with fishing rods

  • Explore caverns and defeat different kinds of enemies!

  • Gather honey from hives.

  • Paws by hitting escape key (I just put that in for the pun, yes)

    In future updates:

  • Grow to be a bigger and older and wiser bear.

  • Trade with other bears!

  • Defeat four different bosses in different locations!

  • Defeat the Moonlight bear in a big boss fight!

    Create your survival hideout and defend yourself from the Zom-Bees!

    Jonas relaxes underwater in a lagoon while it rains...

store_data.about_the_game:
SKEW is a first-person atmospheric exploration game about spaces that feel close to reality, yet quietly wrong.

Wander through liminal, dreamlike environments where structure begins to loosen, perspective feels uncertain, and familiar forms drift slightly out of place. Nothing breaks all at once. Instead, the world slips gradually, creating a constant sense of unease through stillness, scale, and silence.

There are no easy explanations waiting for you here. SKEW is less about being told what to feel, and more about letting you sit inside the feeling itself the tension of empty spaces, the weight of suspended moments, and the strange calm of a reality that no longer aligns with itself.

SKEW does not contain monsters, combat, or jump scares.
Its focus is on atmosphere, emotional tension, and environmental storytelling rather than horror.

Built around mood, visual composition, and surreal exploration, SKEW invites you into a journey suspended somewhere between memory, dream, and distortion.

Features

  • Explore surreal liminal spaces in first person

  • Experience a slow, immersive, atmospheric journey

  • No monsters, no combat, and no jump scares

  • Discover environments shaped by visual storytelling

  • Enter a world that feels familiar, yet subtly misaligned

Welcome to Arthur’s Tale – Where Gravity is Your Worst Enemy!

Arthur is old, he’s tired, and his knees definitely hurt, but he’s not letting a few "minor" obstacles like giant killer robots or bottomless pits stop him. In this stylized 3D platformer, your mission is simple: Don't. Die. (Spoiler: You will.)

What’s waiting for you inside this colorful deathtrap?

  • Precision (or Luck) Platforming: Master every jump with surgical precision, or watch Arthur tumble into the abyss in glorious 60 FPS.

  • Bosses with Bad Attitudes: From forest-dwelling titans to grumpy mechanical sentinels, these guys aren't interested in a friendly chat.

  • Run for Your Life: Experience high-speed chases where stopping to smell the roses results in immediate flattening.

Wishlist now—or Arthur will never hear the end of it!

store_data.about_the_game:
Handwalk is a difficult physics-based 3D rage game where you help a bald man reach the peak of a mountain.

The problem? He can only walk on his hands, and you are the one controlling them.

But how do you handwalk?

It is simple:

1. Lift one hand.

2. Move the hand.

3. Put the hand down.

Do the same with the other hand and... Congratulations, you are walking on your hands.

But if handwalking is so simple, why is it so difficult?

To lift and move one hand, you need to stand only on the other. That is not easy, because the hand you are standing on starts to get tired. Standing with your hands too far apart also drains both hands.

When one of your hands gets completely tired, you fall.

Simply put:

do not stand on one hand or keep your hands too wide for too long.

Good luck on your way to the peak. You will need it.

store_data.about_the_game:
The town of Hidden Town is scared. Very strange things are happening. Villagers claim to have seen the figure of a girl who looks out from the window of one of the houses. Which is very strange, because that house has been abandoned for 20 years.

The Girl in the Window is Dark Dome's first point and click game that would begin the series of a dark town called Hidden Town surrounded by ancient mysteries. In this escape the room suspense thriller game you play Dan, a curious guy who has entered an abandoned house and has been locked up. You will have to solve riddles and puzzles, open drawers and decipher codes, everything in your power to escape the room in this escape puzzle.

This is the introduction to two of our most beloved characters from the Hidden Town universe: Dan and Mia.

You can play the Dark Dome escape room games in any order, you will be able to see how the stories are connected in each chapter to reveal the mysteries of Hidden Town. This is our first episode and it has connections to our fourth escape puzzle game: The ghost Case.

- What you will find in this horror escape mystery game:

A room surrounded by puzzles, objects that move by themselves and characters that come to life. Observe the entire environment to be able to solve mystery case.

An interesting detective story with a lot of mystery and an unexpected plot twist. You won't believe the revealing ending.

A deep and dark art that will make you feel part of this horror mystery adventure from beginning to end.

A complete hint system that can guide you through this interactive detective story whenever you find yourself trapped.

- How to play this suspense thriller game:

Interact with objects in the environment by touching them. Find hidden objects and inventory items in the game or combine them with each other to create a new item to help you continue the story.

Test your wits with these haunted house escape puzzle.

Unravel the Horror Mystery: Dare to Dive Deeper

Are you brave enough to unravel the secrets that lie hidden within the walls of the haunted house? With its gripping suspense thriller storyline and hair-raising atmosphere, this point and click escape puzzle promises an unforgettable gaming experience that will leave you breathless with anticipation.

“Immerse yourself in the enigmatic stories of the Dark Dome escape games and reveal all its secrets. There are still many mysteries to be unraveled in Hidden Town."

store_data.about_the_game:
Story and goal:

You wake up in a cold cell with no memories. Each in-game day, you face a choice: the red door or the blue door. The right path leads forward, the wrong one - a gruesome death. Your goal is to survive 14 days.

Gameplay and challenge:

Only one choice per day - the consequences are always different. One mistake resets your progress completely - you start from day one with no saves.

Unique feature:

The horror here doesn't come from jump scares - it comes from the fact that any mistake is your last. You start over. The only way to win is to remember which doors have killed you before, and keep trying.

Playtime:

30 minutes to several hours - depending on how often you mess up and how well you learn.

Welcome to a terrifying puzzle with no right to make a mistake. Every move you make is being recorded. And someone really wants you to fail.

Millennia ago, they were worshipped as gods. Now, they have returned.

In ancient Sumerian texts, mysterious figures known as the Anunnaki were recorded as the architects of humanity, shaping civilization, until they mysteriously vanished. Until now.

After their disappearance, humanity would discover a vault from a mysterious race called the Ascended Ones. From the knowledge gained, humanity took to the stars, colonizing and exploring the vast galaxy. Humanity’s expansion, however, did not go unnoticed. 

In Astrojumper, play as a Vanguard, and take the fight to both space and on the surface of planets.

Space Combat

Lead humanity’s fleets in large scale, explosive space combat missions. Take control of your Astrojumper in a top down space shooter, and fight alongside your allies against overwhelming odds.

Ground Combat

Land on the surface of occupied planets, and fight the Anunnaki directly in a side-scroller shooter. Utilize an array of weapons and tools to defeat your foes, and collect scrap to upgrade your gear and ship.

Exploring the Galaxy

Navigate occupied star systems with a map inspired by that of Mass Effect. Travel to a variety of planets, each with unique environments and designs.

store_data.about_the_game:
Daifugo x Roguelite! Strategic HP-based Card Battle

This is a competitive card game that combines the familiar rules of the classic card game "Daifugo" with roguelite progression elements.

【Key Game Systems】

  • Thrilling Damage Calculation: When you cannot play a card (pass), you take direct damage to your HP. The damage is calculated as: [Total value of cards on the field] x [Multiplier].

  • Post-Victory Shop Phase: After winning a battle, you will move to the shop.

  • Deck Customization: Build your deck by obtaining special cards and additional cards.

Build a deck that suits your style and defeat your enemies!

[About Online Multiplayer]

This game supports online multiplayer for two players. You can easily play with friends by following the steps below.

  • Host: Go to Multiplayer, create a lobby, and share the generated “Lobby ID” with your opponent.

  • Guest: Go to Multiplayer, enter the shared ID, and join to access the specific lobby.

*An internet connection is required to play.

*Please note that the random matchmaking feature with players worldwide is not currently available, so you can only play against friends.

store_data.about_the_game:
Arms Dealer Simulator is a simulation game, where you manage a massive arms distribution empire and everything from assembly lines to logistic operations.You pick contracts and prepare orders by buying necessary weapons, parts and ammunition. You will be building guns, organizing and packaging massive amounts of weaponry and delivering them with your own scalable logistics fleet to grow your empire.

Supply and demand are the heart of your business. Place your orders and monitor the arrival of fresh stock as crates and components roll into your facility through the automated delivery system.

The workshop is where the magic happens. Roll up your sleeves and engage in the process of crafting weapons, transforming loose parts into a finished product that’s ready for the field.

A cluttered workspace leads to a slow delivery. Master the art of inventory management by neatly sorting your stock and optimizing your storage chests for maximum efficiency.

The final step before the hand-off is ensuring everything is packed tight. Close the lids on your fully stocked crates and double-check that your inventory is locked, loaded, and ready to ship.

The heavy work is done; now comes the payoff. Dispatch your fleet of trucks across the world to complete your contracts and watch your empire grow with every successful delivery.

store_data.about_the_game:
Frostward is a 4X survival strategy game set in a frozen world on the brink of collapse. Build and defend the last bastion of civilization, manage heat and resources, explore the deadly wasteland, and lead expeditions into the unknown.

Combining city-building, base defense, and large-scale strategic progression, Frostward challenges you to survive not only against the cold, but against the growing threats hidden beyond the storm.

Redesigned from the ground up as the successor to Epoch of Guardians, every major system—from technology and resource management to unit progression and enemy behavior—has been rebuilt to create a deeper, more scalable survival strategy experience.

Clear the Snow, Reveal the Unknown

Send investigators to clear snow-covered tiles and uncover the terrain and resources buried beneath the frozen world. Cleared land may transform into more productive terrain, while hidden resources, abandoned structures, and stranded survivors await discovery.

Plan and Optimize Your Settlement

Design your settlement on a hex-grid map where buildings vary in size, shape, and orientation. Carefully manage space and maximize adjacency bonuses between structures and resources. Mines placed near ore deposits increase construction output, while schools built beside housing improve education production.

Fortify the Frontier Against the Frozen Unknown

Your settlement will face relentless threats emerging from the frozen wilderness. Construct defensive structures, establish layered fortifications, and command your forces in turn-based hex-grid battles. Combine abilities, terrain, and defensive lines to survive against the cold and the unknown forces beyond the frontier.

Hold the Line Against Massive Invasions

As your civilization expands, increasingly dangerous enemies will emerge from the frozen frontier. Build layered defenses with barricades, trenches, watchtowers, snipers, and artillery, then command large-scale battles across the hex-grid battlefield. Unleash powerful abilities to break enemy assaults and turn the tide of war.

Compared to other survival games:

  • Turn-based gameplay reduces pressure.

  • Replayability through random map generation.

  • Deeper strategic depth.

  • Dynamically adaptive difficulty.

Compared to other 4X games:

  • Clearer, more defined victory objectives.

  • Expanded tactical options.

  • Hero progression and customization.

  • Asymmetric competition.

  • Lightweight & Snappy.

Compared to Epoch of Guardians:

  • Spiritual successor with brand-new systems.

  • Streamlined, less cumbersome controls.

  • More distinctive unit designs.

  • Fully realized, physical building structures.

store_data.about_the_game:
Nova Strider is a top-down sci-fi score-attack game that takes place high up in the atmosphere.

A hostile alien army is attempting a surprise invasion of the planet. And as the sole captain of the Strider, you play as humanity's last line of defense against the invading forces. 

-- Gameplay --

Blow up aliens using your rocket-boosters!

Dashing is the only way to move, so every input counts. After a while, enemies start spawning in linked pairs, making them invulnerable until their link is broken. Use short dashes for positioning and charged heavy dashes to attack once you've found the perfect angle.

Every kill increases your score multiplier, but getting hit instantly resets it. Plan your movements carefully and try to keep the multiplier alive for as long as possible!

-- Local leaderboard --

The game features a leaderboard that locally keeps track of and ranks each players high-score.

After every run, you can choose to save your score to the leaderboard by entering your name.

Technology, Magic, and Immortals collide in a universe torn apart by endless aggression. War is total; even the laws of existence are erased. Lead your fleets to invade worlds across the stars.

Gameplay Guide

1.Select Planets:​ Use the Left Mouse Button​ to draw a selection box. Selected planets allow you to dispatch fleets and cast skills.

2.Attack:​ Right-click​ on any planet to command your ships to attack along viable routes or to redirect your fleet.

3.Activate Skills:​ Select the planet to use the skill from, then click the skill bar or press the hotkeys Q, W, E, R, T​ to unleash abilities.

4.Random Rewards:​ When the numerical value on a planet reaches its maximum and stops growing, a random reward will be granted.

How to Play Multiplayer

1.Open the Multiplayer Panel.

2.Hosting:​ Create a Host directly, then close the multiplayer panel (Note:​ Do not click "Cancel Online") and start the game.

3.Joining:​ Open the Multiplayer Panel, enter the Host's IP address, click "Join Game," and then start playing.

Steam Multiplayer:​ The process is similar to LAN play; simply join a lobby where other players are present.

1.Open the Multiplayer Panel.

2.Hosting:​ Create a Host directly, then close the multiplayer panel (Note:​ Do not click "Cancel Online") and start the game.

3.Joining:​ Open the Multiplayer Panel, enter the Host's IP address, click "Join Game," and then start playing.

store_data.about_the_game:
A monster-taming RPG built around discovery, strategy, and meaningful exploration.

Catch and train Qreatures, master 28 unique elements, and explore a world where every path leads to something meaningful.

Then, if you want to get even more creative, unlock the Qreature Lab and start creating entirely new species!

More variety, new battle mechanics and strategies.

28 elemental types. 18 classics that feel familiar plus 10 new types including Time, Quantum, Plasma and Radioactive 

Experiment with time manipulation, delayed effects, irradiation and more interactions that don’t exist in traditional systems.

Plus some major re-balancing of some more traditional mechanics.

Battles are built to stay challenging — not something you outgrow.

Scaling trainers and Qreature Masters
You can’t just overlevel and win. Team strategy matters.

1v1 and 2v2 combat
Build teams that actually work together.

Some rivals even select a team to counter your current party.

Exploration isn’t filler — it’s progression.

Rare monsters hidden off the main path and powerful items and abilities to discover.

New traversal mechanics that open up the world over time and day/night cycles and weather systems that impact gameplay.

You’re constantly finding things that matter.

New Qreatures will be added into the world with regular free content updates.

New monsters aren’t locked behind paywalls.

Even if you never use the Qreature Lab the game keeps growing.

Scan real-world QR codes to create completely unique Qreatures.

You can still find monsters in the wild like normal—but you can also scan real-world QR codes to generate entirely new ones in the Qreature Lab!

The possibilities are basically endless.

Breed in the Qreature Lab to create entirely new species.

Cross-breeding will result in a brand new monster that actually looks like it's parents, combining visual characteristics and inherited stats from both to create somthing new. 

And because those traits carry forward—

you can keep building on them over generations.

"A lot of open worlds are just… big.   Not meaningful."

"I want every corner of this world to matter  -  find hidden secrets, abilities, unique monsters, items, even new mechanics."

"A world that actually rewards your curiosity."

"That feeling of wondering what’s just over the next hill.... 

that’s the whole point."

" It’s an open world monster collector… but I’m trying to fix a lot of the things that always bothered me about the genre. "

 THE QREATURE LAB

If you want to get creatuive, you’ll eventually unlock the Qreature Lab.

This is where things get really....weird.

  • Scan real-world QR codes
    Turn them into completely unique monsters.

  • Breed your creatures
    Offspring inherit traits from both parents — visually and mechanically.

  • Discover new species
    You don’t control the result — but your choices shape it.

Every result is a surprise.
Every experiment pushes things further.

YOU PAY TO CREATE — NOT TO WIN

You can:

  • explore the full world

  • catch hundreds of monsters

  • complete the story

  • build strong teams

Everything you need for a full RPG experience is included in the base game.

The Lab is where things change.

Generating new Qreatures through QR scanning and breeding uses real-time cloud processing, so it has a real cost behind it.

You’ll get a number of free Lab uses included with the game so you can experiment and see what’s possible.

After that, you can:

  • earn occasional additional uses through gameplay

  • or choose to purchase more if you want to keep experimenting

There’s also an optional companion app for players who want to scan QR codes on the go and sync their unique discoveries directly to their Steam library.

No pay-to-win.
No forced spending.
Just optional creativity.

A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER

I’m building this game solo — learning as I go.

World Of Qreatures started as a simple idea:
“What if a monster game never ran out of new things to discover?”

That led to:

  • a deeper battle system

  • a more meaningful open world

  • and eventually… the Lab

The Lab is the most experimental part of the game.
It uses real-time cloud generation, which means it costs money to run every time it’s used.

I’ve tried to design it in a way that’s fair and transparent:

  • You get a complete RPG experience with your purchase

  • You get free Lab uses to try it out

  • You can earn more through gameplay

  • And if you enjoy it, you can choose to use it more

There’s also an optional companion app for players who want to scan QR codes on the go and sync their unique discoveries directly to their Steam library.

I know this approach won’t be for everyone — and that’s okay.

If you enjoy experimenting and discovering new creatures, you’ll probably love it.
If not, you can still enjoy the game for everything else it offers.

The Earth is on a collision course with a relentless swarm of asteroids.

A mysterious celestial traveler known as the "Ark" arrives to save humanity, loading every last person on board. But there's a slight problem: "Yikes... I don't think the planet itself is going to fit."

With no other choice, the Ark wields the Earth as a giant weapon, smashing through asteroid fields in a desperate search for a new home for mankind.

BRICKFALL

BRICKFALL is an arcade action experience that fuses the satisfying "thwack" of classic brick-breaking with roguelike progression and intense boss battles.

  • Smash & Collect: Obliterate bricks to gather valuable XP orbs.

  • Build Your Power: Unlock devastating upgrades with every level-up to create unstoppable synergies.

  • Conquer the Cosmos: Fight through challenging stages and push your limits in Infinite Mode to claim the high score.

  • The Cycle of Growth: No run is ever wasted. Your hard-earned XP converts to Gold upon a Game Over.

  • Evolve Permanently: Spend Gold to unlock permanent power-ups and return stronger for your next voyage through the stars.

store_data.about_the_game:
Enter Slashbang, a narrative driven, movement-first first person shooter taking inspiration from games like Sonic Adventure, Jet Set Radio, and the Metal Gear series.

Speed through levels with a completely unique, custom tailored movement system, shoot and slice terrorists to pieces, and take part in a narrative adventure with intrigue, high tensions, and a comedic core.

  • NEW MOVEMENT SYSTEM - Based on design principles of Sonic games, Slashbang has more originality than just rocket jumps and bunny hopping. Drift around corners, dodge bullets in a blink, and run up walls. Easy to learn, hard to master!

  • DESTRUCTION - Slice through incoming bullets, props, and even enemies with Flynn's claws! Environments are destructible, and enemies can be shredded to pieces.

  • NONLINEAR PROGRESSION - Slashbang aims to have a somewhat nonlinear progression system without the down sides. Levels are hand crafted, and you can choose the order you tackle them to gain new weapons.

  • STYLE - With a unique low poly, toon shaded art style akin to Jet Set Radio, and a soundtrack by Reski that evokes Hideki Naganuma and Jun Senoue, Slashbang has sights and sounds that will keep you coming back to get faster times.

  • SUBSTANCE - Slashbang aims to have a gripping and funny story about absolute power and how it propagates. Join David, his Spector, Flynn, and a variety of other characters as they try to restore order to their city under military occupation.

⚠️ Please read the following before purchasing

Marathon:Glory Run is a side-scrolling runner set in 490 BC, recreating Pheidippides' legendary 42-kilometer run from the Marathon plain to Athens with the news of victory. Please read the following before purchasing:

【Product Scope】 This is a relatively simple side-scrolling endless runner. While wrapped in historical storytelling, the core mechanics — jump, dodge, collect — are similar to mainstream runners like Temple Run or Subway Surfers. If you're seeking deep complexity or innovative mechanics, this may not meet your expectations.

【Content Volume】 Current version includes 6 terrain stages, 8 milestone events, 4 item types, and 5 obstacle types. As an indie developer title, total content is limited. After reaching Athens, subsequent playthroughs offer essentially the same content with no multi-run inheritance or deep roguelike mechanics.

【Replayability】 Runners inherently involve repetition. This title offers mid-game variety through combo systems and dual-resource management (Stamina/Will), but randomly generated obstacle/item combinations cannot guarantee a significantly different experience each run. Players expecting "blind-box surprise" every time may be disappointed.

【Narrative vs Gameplay】 Historical narration at milestones (background on the Greco-Persian Wars) is presented as plain text and does not deeply interact with gameplay mechanics. For players seeking an immersive narrative experience, the story elements function more like skippable说明书 than a story-driven design integrated into gameplay.

【Technical Limitations】 • Landscape mode only — vertical orientation on mobile or tablet will not work properly • No cloud save — progress will not transfer between devices • No achievements, leaderboards, or multiplayer features

【Update Expectations】 As an individual/small team project, update frequency and future content expansion are uncertain. No fixed update schedule or major content expansions can be promised.

【Difficulty Test】 This game has undergone internal testing by the development team and is quite difficult to pass. So far, no one has successfully completed it. If you prefer games that are easy to pass, this product is not for you.Of course, we also hope that skilled gamers will successfully complete the game and point out any problems in our product so that we can improve it.

【Good fit for:】 ✅ Players deeply interested in marathon or ancient Greek history ✅ Players who enjoy simple, direct runner controls ✅ Players willing to pay a low price for a complete single-journey experience

【Not a good fit for:】 ❌ Players seeking deep systemic complexity or innovative mechanics ❌ Players wanting rich social features (leaderboards/multiplayer/achievements) ❌ Hardcore players with high expectations for replayability

In the distant future, AI has permeated every corner of human society.

You will play the role of the new police officer, Ryan Sinclair, in the floating city "New Babylon" and the abandoned industrial area "Old Babylon". You will investigate a series of abnormal events triggered by AI. On the surface, this is just an ordinary law enforcement mission; but as the truth gradually emerges, you will discover that the conflict between humans and AI has already reached an irreparable abyss.

Are they merely machines that act according to the code, or are they already conscious beings?

The future of humanity, the fate of AI, and this world on the verge of collapse - ultimately, they will all be placed in your hands.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are not the hero.

You are an automated strategic war system, designation unknown. You've just rebooted after 800 years offline. Your standing orders are still active. The war continues.

Or does it?

MIND PRISON: THE LAST WAR is a narrative-driven strategy game presented through a retro military terminal interface. Every cycle, you make decisions: deploy fleets, capture sectors, manage resources, and respond to events across a dying galaxy. Every choice shapes your path toward one of eight possible endings.

But something is wrong. Your scans return impossible data. Your orders contradict themselves. And deep in your corrupted memory banks, fragments of classified reports are surfacing—revealing a truth you were never meant to remember.

---

Features

Command a Galactic War

- Capture and control 24 sectors across an abstract star map

- Build fleets, infantry, and devastating weapons

- Research upgrades to enhance your war machine

- Face a rival AI competing for the same territory

Uncover the Truth

- 12 corrupted memory fragments reveal the story piece by piece

- The deeper you go, the darker it gets

- What really happened 800 years ago?

Multiple Paths, Multiple Endings

- 8 distinct endings based on your choices and playstyle

- Will you conquer everything? Protect what remains? Or shut yourself down?

- Your actions determine what kind of machine you become

Progression That Persists

- Unlock new buildings and weapons based on your lifetime performance

- New Game+ mode with escalating challenges

- 30+ achievements tracking your path across multiple playthroughs

Authentic Terminal Aesthetic

- Green text on black. CRT scanlines. No Frills.

- Pure military terminal atmosphere

- Every screen designed to feel like classified hardware

---

You were built to win a war.

But what happens when there's no one left to fight?

What happens when there's no one left at all?

Why are you still running?

---

MIND PRISON: THE LAST WAR — Because no one told you to stop.

store_data.about_the_game:
NOITABIL is a first-person psychological horror game. You wake up somewhere you don't remember being. Each room asks something different, and none of them quite belong together. You make choices and decide what to do. Every action you take is being recorded and shapes the dialogue, the visuals, and what you can perceive.

Playtime is around 2-3 hours. There are three endings, depending on how you played. Webcam and microphone are used during play. Recordings stay on your device. Nothing is uploaded, transmitted, or shared. The game is playable without them, but the experience is designed around their use. Don't play in a well-lit room.

store_data.about_the_game:
You woke up here. You don't know why. Neither do we.

The Secret Squirrel Syndicate controls everything — the gear, the zones, the paperwork. You're a S.H.I.T. agent (Sanitary Health Inspection Team) and you've been sent to find Dessert Protocol One. Classified. Dangerous.

When you die — and you will — squirrels in suits will confiscate your equipment. All of it. Professionally. With documentation.

What happens next is up to you.

INFILTRATE PARODY WORLDS Fellout: Nut World. Castle Squirrelstein. Black Squirrel Mesa. GLaDOS Has Your Nuts. Every zone is a dimension unto itself — and every dimension has a Syndicate presence.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY Go loud, go quiet, or go smart. Combat, stealth, and tech approaches to every situation. The Syndicate adapts. So should you.

LOOT. LOSE IT. GET IT BACK. Gear drops in tiers — from Piece of Shit to The Shit. Bank your junk loot for Nuts. Upgrade your weapons. Try not to die before you reach a terminal.

NEGOTIATE WITH AGENT SQUIRREL Professional. Weary. In possession of all your things. How you handle this conversation matters.

RAID THE VAULT Procedurally generated security. One boss. The Nutmaster remembers you. He's not happy about it.

Coming 2028 to Steam and Xbox Series X|S. Developed by Atlas Labs Games.

store_data.about_the_game: 《Shackle of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，核心围绕战斗中的束缚、突破与反制展开。玩家将在压抑的战斗环境中，判断何时挣脱限制、何时承受压力，通过对枷锁状态的掌控来主导战局走向。游戏中的每一场战斗，敌我双方都可能施加各类束缚效果，压制行动、削弱输出或限制技能使用。玩家需要在被约束的条件下审视行动顺序与资源分配，选择是积蓄力量一举突破，还是忍耐消耗等待时机。不同敌人所施加的枷锁类型与节奏各异，迫使玩家不断调整挣脱与承受之间的策略边界。随着流程推进，角色将获得更多解除束缚、转守为攻的手段，同时也能强化自身在受限制状态下的生存与反击能力。整个体验始终围绕“束缚与解放”这一核心张力，要求玩家在被压制的局势中寻找破局之道，将劣势转化为可控的节奏。《Shackle of Y》为喜爱传统回合制 RPG 的玩家提供一段以枷锁管理、抵抗与突破为主题的单人冒险，在持续的压迫与反制中完成完整攻略。

store_data.about_the_game:
MARA: RELICS OF THE FORGOTTEN

Play as Mara — freelance treasure hunter, rogue archaeologist, and reluctant expert on things that probably should have stayed buried. When the maps run out and the trails go cold, that's where her work begins.

Track down lost relics across crumbling ruins, flooded vaults, and places forgotten for very good reason.

EXPLORE A WORLD THAT DOESN'T WANT TO BE FOUND From frost-bitten wastelands to ancient depths swallowed by time, navigate treacherous environments by vehicle and on foot. The road to your destination is long, unforgiving, and rarely empty.

DEAL WITH THREATS YOUR WAY Every enemy encounter is a choice. Go in loud and take them out by force — or read the room, slip through the shadows, and ghost out before they ever knew you were there. Violence is an option. So is patience.

UNRAVEL ENVIRONMENTAL PUZZLES Scattered notes, worn journals, and cryptic inscriptions hold the keys to sealed chambers and ancient mechanisms. Pay attention — the ruins are trying to tell you something.

SCAVENGE. CRAFT. ADAPT. The world is full of things worth picking up:

  • 💰 Coins — Trade with merchants for weapons, gear, and ammo

  • 🔧 Salvageable items — Combine materials to craft healing supplies and ammunition

  • 💊 Pills — Upgrade your skills and push Mara beyond her limits

  • 🎵 Music records — Collect and play them back for a little humanity in a very inhuman world

Some relics were buried for a reason. Mara's going to find out why.

ABOUT THIS GAME

Lunar Tears is an 18+ BL/yaoi romance visual novel set in an apocalyptic world where werewolves have become the dominant species.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bubble Mage is a game where you play as a bubble mage exploring a series of floating islands. It's up to you and the utilization of your bubble powers to solve puzzles and interact with the land's native inhabitants, elemental slimes. Explore this world of interconnected islands, solve puzzles, and experiment with new equipment as you journey through the world of Bubble Mage!

What Makes a Mage a Bubble Mage? 

You'll find your magic to be quite... well... magical! Your bubbles can be used to peacefully navigate the islands. Step on top of your bubbles and move them around, riding them around between mountains. Time it right and when you jump on them you'll go bounced up beyond your usual heights, going higher and higher with each bounce. Place your bubbles strategically and form a sort of staircase to jump your way up steep cliffs you can't walk up. If peacefully navigating isn't your way of bubbling, explore combat with the island's inhabitants. Use your bubbles to trap them or hurl them away from yourself. With the right magical enchantments on your equipment, even your small bubbles can find a use - damaging slimes on contact. Make up your own magical tactics for traversing these islands and harness your full potential as the first bubble mage these lands have seen!

Explore a Variety of Islands!

Explore flowery fields, forested woods, and towering mountains as you venture off looking for quests and puzzles to solve! Bubble Mage's world is home to a variety of different landscapes and islands, with forests of different trees, flowering bushes and fruit, and mountains and valleys for brave bubble mages to scale. Set off across these islands, exploring the terrains, and see exactly what your bubble magic is capable of! Will you make it through your explorations intact or will a poorly timed bubble pop send you plummeting to a tough fall? 

Find Hidden Quests!

Rise to face the challenges the islands present and bring order to this chaotically cute floating archipelago. Scattered across the vibrant world of Bubble Mage are unique tasks and puzzles waiting to be discovered. Some require expertise with your magic, others require the involvement of the island's slimes, and others can involve all these things and a touch of puzzling. Use your bubbles, wit, and the island's slimes to complete these tasks!

Capture Slimes!

Use your bubble magic to capture and move slimes while also drawing out their latent elemental powers. Fight and capture slimes across each of the islands. Each unique slime type has its own element and style of fighting. Plant, water, fire - explore the combinations between your bubbles and their elements and watch out for their not quite vicious but still harmful attacks.

Experiment with Customizable Equipment!

Dress for synergy, style, or both! Fashion in the wizard world is ever-changing, and bubble mages are no exception. Try out a wide spread of stat-changing equipment as you adventure your way through Bubble Mage. These cute customizables let you express yourself as a mage while also applying advantageous power-ups! Standard equipment can offer a variety of boons - from raising mana and health to increasing bubble size or decreasing cooldown. Some more special items have one-of-a-kind effects, like plant elemental-infused boots that heal you as you walk or a sinister hat that damages slimes at the cost of your own health. Find your own look as a bubble mage, looking classy or cutesy or even shabby if that's your style. Take your equipment to the test on the islands, seeing which effects work best for you and which visuals suit you the most.

store_data.about_the_game:
You remember this place.

The peeling walls.
The buzzing fluorescent lights.
The endless Soviet hallways that never seemed to end.

But you have never been here before.

Somewhere in the darkness, you hear footsteps behind you.

When you turn around, the corridor is empty.


Soviet Backrooms is an atmospheric first-person survival horror game set inside a liminal nightmare of abandoned post-Soviet interiors, distorted memories, and oppressive silence.


Explore decaying apartments, forgotten stairwells, endless corridors, and dead spaces frozen somewhere between reality and a nightmare you cannot escape.


Enter the Soviet liminal nightmare



Wander through unsettling environments inspired by post-Soviet architecture — dim Khrushchyovka hallways, abandoned buildings, flickering lights, cracked tiles, and suffocating silence.


Every location feels disturbingly familiar, like a forgotten memory that was never meant to return.


Something is following you



The deeper you go, the more the world begins to change.


Listen carefully.
The sounds behind you are getting closer.


  • Oppressive post-Soviet liminal environments

  • Psychological horror focused on tension and immersion

  • Explore abandoned apartments, corridors, stairwells, and underground spaces

  • Disturbing atmosphere inspired by analog and liminal horror

  • Unseen threats stalking you through the silence


You are searching for a way out.

But this place does not want to let you leave.

store_data.about_the_game:
COLD PAWS is based on the first story from our private fantasy novel of the same name "(Cold Paws)". It is an action RPG with real life stories of our cat "Chitti" and many stray animals.
Players take on the roles of an Orange Stray Cat named Chitti and a Bernese Mountain Dog Puppy named Mounti. Players will also experience the story through humans and elves, depending on the story. The story follows an orange stray cat standing beside a puppy against all odds, caught in a vast, chaotic cosmic drama played by the universe. It explores the situations they face and how they overcome many challenges in their world. There will be a wide range of characters in this cosmic journey. The game covers the first story of the novel, allowing players to experience it interactively.

The game takes place on a beautiful small planet filled with breathtaking landscapes and extreme weather conditions. Cold Paws is not a sci-fi game—it is grounded in human emotions and real-life experiences, presented through a fantasy setting. We will add few gameplay features here without revealing story and secrete features.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES


A. Character roles :

1.Player will be playing as multiple characters, including Animals, Humans, and Elves.

2.Unique animal traversal systems (running, jumping, climbing on to the walls and Objects, interactions and Many more Locomotion Features with a beautiful Gameplay Animations).Chitti does all kinds of cat things while protecting Mounti, and Mounti behaves like a playful cute puppy. We’d also like to share a thing that: the game isn’t just about the cat and the puppy. There are more main characters in the story that players will get to play as according to the Novel. We are trying to give best possible experience we can give with a game. We are slaves to the story. what story demands, we design that in the game.

Chitti is our real cat, and some of the most emotional parts of the game actually come from her real-life experiences. Mounti is a fictional character inspired from one of our mountain dogs.

B. Visual storytelling : 

3.Story Focused gameplay on a beautiful planet blending winter and greenery scenarios.

4.Dynamic weather and atmospheric conditions affecting gameplay using player character location.

5.Over-the-top action RPG with a distinct style of combat choreography. a fresh approach in Game Industry.

6.Emotion-driven storytelling through character bonds and environmental design.

7.Cinematic moments and immersive visual presentation, along with Interactive QTEs.

8.A Specifically Directed Art style which is very important for Cold Paws to bring unique feeling.

9.Storytelling with minimal dialogue and real animal vocalizations—partly due to our small team, even though the original Cold Paws novel uses human-dubbed animal voices.

10.We really want players to smile, laugh, cry, and feel every emotion—a true rollercoaster—as closely as possible to the novel. We have written story in a different style than how games operate. We will really do our best even though we are a tiny team.

11.Ultra realistic Art (Humans and Animals along with environments). We spent 10 years figuring out best ways to do Art with the most optimized tricks and techniques while helping other Big games.

C. Technical Details :

12.Gamepad friendly. 

13.Semi-open worlds where players can move freely and experience environmental storytelling.

D. Important rules we set for ColdPaws : 

Cold Paws is a story-driven game, so we’ve set a few rules to keep it as close to the novel as possible.

14.Enemies are story-driven, not randomly spawned - no pointless encounters.

15.No collectibles or in-app purchases—no collecting items without purpose. Because it makes no sense for this game.

16.We will not be having Any UI spam on the screen, So we can give maximum cinematic experience. We will keep them as minimal as possible.

17.We will not be having repetitive tasks. 

18.As a small team, we’re not overloading the game with too many mechanics. only the ones that truly matter. So players can easily enjoy the game. We feel game has to be fun not too difficult.

E. Exceptions : 

19.We will include Easter eggs in the game—hidden pictures of our top supporters’ pets and people who actively help stray animals in real life with their permission.

We can’t wait to show all of this visually very soon.

About Us

We’ve revealed as much as we can about the game above. And Now we can talk about us. Who are we

We are Mountaindog Studios, We are not a large team with a big financial budget. Instead, our resources are our passion, skills, time, and lot of love for animals.

We have spent over 10 years studying art and game engine specifically for this story, and we have also worked on multiple AAA titles. However, this is our first independent game. Our goal is to bring our private novel to life through action RPG Games and tell the story visually, rather than just through words.

We have developed an unique art style to present the game in a fresh way. We want players to experience a true emotional rollercoaster, offering something new and different from traditional games.

Why Cold Paws

What drives us to create COLD PAWS is deeply personal. The story is inspired by real-life experiences we have gone through and witnessed:

1.Many people ignore small animals on the streets, and countless animals suffer from hunger. We hope that one day, people will take just five minutes to feed hungry animals living in the cold under cars and on the streets.

2.We have seen many people chase away stray animals by beating them or throwing stones, causing them severe harm. This should not be happening. Creating awareness through visual storytelling can help—even if only a little—and encourage people to think before hurting any stray animal.

3.Many people only care about expensive animals. We want to show that stray animals can be just as loving and caring.

4.We have experienced situations where helping stray animals or keeping them as pets leads to judgment from others, as some people believe animals are dirty or bring misfortune. There are also some people who don’t like it when others feed stray animals.

And there are many more experiences we cannot share here—some of them are even more heartbreaking, which we may open up about eventually.

We wish COLD PAWS delivers memorable experiences and inspires people to show more kindness toward stray animals even if it’s just taking five minutes to offer them some food.

4.We have experienced situations where helping stray animals or keeping them as pets leads to judgment from others, as some people believe animals are dirty or bring misfortune. There are also some people who don’t like it when others feed stray animals.

We wish COLD PAWS delivers memorable experiences and inspires people to show more kindness toward stray animals even if it’s just taking five minutes to offer them some food.

NIGHTMIST is a tactical, body-cam styled PVE horror experience that plunges you into a dense, atmospheric forest shrouded in a supernatural fog. As a solo operative, you must navigate high-tension environments where visibility is your greatest enemy and sound is your only warning.

KEY FEATURES

• Hyper-Realistic Body-Cam Perspective: Experience the horror through a claustrophobic, high-fidelity lens designed to blur the lines between game and reality.

• Tactical PVE Combat: Engage in slow, methodical gunplay where every shot counts. Manage your ammunition and resources carefully while facing intelligent AI threats that hunt you through the mist.

• Atmospheric Horror: Utilize advanced volumetric lighting and fog effects that react to your movements, creating a constantly shifting environment where danger hides in every shadow.

• Objective-Based Gameplay: Complete high-stakes missions within the forest, retrieving vital data or clearing infested zones before the "Nightmist" consumes your position.

• Immersive Sound Design: A deep, spatial audio system ensures that every twig snap and distant growl is a gameplay cue, forcing you to rely on your ears as much as your eyes.

store_data.about_the_game:
0% IA | 100% human

Most tower defense games ask you to survive forever. Risk The Crown asks something harder.

When is the exact moment to run?

You are the Defender — the one standing between a relentless army of monsters and your king. Every night the enemies grow stronger. Every coin you earn is one more reason to stay. But the longer you wait, the closer everything gets to falling apart.

When you finally call the retreat, the king doesn't just vanish. He walks. Your troops fight around him. Enemies don't stop attacking. Coins keep piling up. He can still die on his way out. You haven't won yet.

That's the game. That's the feeling.

How to play

  • Pick your troops — before the first enemy arrives, choose who fights for you.

  • Survive the night — waves pour in, enemies grow stronger each cycle. Hold the line.

  • Upgrade between rounds — choose one card after each night. Every decision matters.

  • Call the retreat — at the right moment. Not too soon. Not too late.

  • Escort the king to safety — the final gauntlet. Stay alive long enough for him to escape.

Two ways to play

  • Campaign — 20 to 60-minute runs with permanent upgrades and an expanding roster. Every run you're a little stronger. Every run the right moment to flee is harder to find.

  • Rush Mode — 3 to 8 minutes. Four difficulty settings. A leaderboard. Jump in, escape, beat your score. No setup needed.

Key features

  • The retreat is not a loss — it's the win condition.

  • Enemies scale exponentially. Your rewards grow slower. The math always catches up.

  • Your troop choice locks in before you see a single enemy. No take-backs.

  • Runs short enough for a lunch break. Deep enough to think about afterwards.

store_data.about_the_game:
Provisions Are Heaven, Life and Death on a Thread

Provisions move before troops. Here, grain is far more than a number — it is the lifeline that can decide an entire campaign. Every soldier and every warhorse consumes supplies in real time, and you must personally plan the routes of your supply convoys, guarding them fiercely against enemy interception. Once your supply lines are cut and granaries run empty, your army will rapidly starve: morale collapses, stamina drains, soldiers begin disobeying orders and fleeing, and an elite force can disintegrate in an instant. You must personally oversee grain allocation, establish military farms, plunder enemy storehouses, and even consider “foraging off the enemy” in desperate straits — the most brutal yet most authentic way to keep your army alive. This unforgiving logistics system forces every commander to calculate every last grain before a campaign. Every expedition is the ultimate test of resource mastery.

A Tide of Foes, Seamless Offense and Defense

The enemy will never sit idle. They will hurl themselves at your defenses in relentless, endless waves, and AI commanders will even adjust troop compositions and shift the focus of their assault based on losses. Amid the frantic moments between defensive actions, you must direct your soldiers to hold the gates, plug breaches, and withstand wave after wave of all-out, suicidal attack. And once the city is successfully defended, the roles reverse in an instant — you can lead your rested, full-strength army out on the offensive, suppress internal rebellions, wipe out roving bandits, or even launch a long-range raid to strike enemy cities, carrying the war onto their soil and turning the tide from defense to attack.

Diverse Troops, Devious Formations

You can train distinct troop types such as spearmen, sword-and-shield infantry, archers, crossbowmen, light cavalry, and heavy cavalry. Every unit possesses its own attack, defense, movement speed, cost, and footprint on the battlefield, all governed by a complete rock-paper-scissors counter system. Before battle, you will freely drag, rotate, and position formation blocks on a grand sand table, meticulously arranging your forward barrier troops, main battle line, flanks, and reserves. From classic formations like the Fish Scale and the Crane Wing to your own irregular skirmish patterns, the choice is entirely yours. Exploit unit counter relationships and the advantage of deep positioning to disrupt the enemy’s line of advance before the clash even begins, forcing them to blunder headlong into the death trap you have designed.

Boundless Battlefields, Dynamic Warfare

Throw yourself into a fully open, dynamic battlefield. You can use complex terrain — mountains, forests, rivers, slopes, and ravines — to lay pocket ambushes or fight with your back to the water, achieving victory against overwhelming odds through formation placement and terrain advantage. On the battlefield, a dynamic weather system forces you to adapt: torrential rain slackens bowstrings, extinguishes fire arrows, and turns the ground into mud that bogs down heavy infantry; dense fog hides movements, ideal for surprise attacks but also a risk of stumbling into traps; scorching sun accelerates water consumption, and bitter winter blizzards drastically reduce the combat power of troops not outfitted for the cold. At the same time, a unique random character system generates distinctive wandering champions, bandit chieftains, reclusive geniuses, and even hidden legendary strategists of the enemy faction. They may suddenly charge into the fray or defect in the heat of battle, filling every siege and field engagement with unpredictable variables.

Impregnable Fortress – Building Defense in Depth

Defense is not a single thin wall — it is layer upon layer of progressively reinforced killing barriers. You can construct thick rammed-earth walls, later upgraded to brick-faced stone fortifications, and erect multi-story arrow towers, ballista platforms, and trebuchet emplacements atop them. Beyond the gates, you can add barbicans, iron portcullises, and pit traps, shaping a three-dimensional defensive line of “outer moat – rampart – main wall – inner partitions.” As you invest resources, you will unlock sequential trap arrays, rolling-log and rock-launching frames, and cascading cauldrons of burning oil, transforming every inch of your position into an insurmountable wall for the enemy. True siege warfare is not a contest of numbers — it is a brutal war of attrition and a battle of wits.

City Management, Steady Accumulation

A comprehensive city management system demands you govern your domain like a true protector of the realm. You must meticulously balance grain reserves, timber, stone, iron, and other strategic resources; expand dwellings to attract refugees, thereby broadening your tax base and recruitment pool; and plan farmlands, markets, workshops, academies, and other production and research buildings, striking a balance between civilian welfare and military industry. Population demographics, public loyalty, and corvée labor burdens all dynamically influence the stability of your city and the efficiency of conscription. Only by laying a rock-solid logistical foundation can you sustain the long, grinding war for supremacy.

Assembling Heroes, Chance and Conquest

The vast world map is scattered with rich, diverse random events: mountain bandits on the prowl, urgent distress calls from villages, fierce champions hidden in ancient temples, lost texts buried in ruins, or even an open-air scholarly gathering. Along the road, you will encounter commanders of unique skills and backgrounds. There is more than one way to bring them under your banner: inspire them with virtue and honor, entice them with wealth, promise them official rank, or, after shattering their army on the battlefield, persuade them to surrender, imprison and convert them, or even capture an enemy general and break their will through persistent psychological assault until they genuinely pledge their loyalty. Every officer holds their own personal code of loyalty and distinct preferences. Whether you can gather the realm’s finest talents into your fold depends entirely on your methods.

Unique Hero Development & Combo Mastery

You will personally forge unique, top-tier warriors in the heat of battle. Every general follows their own growth path: by slaying enemies in live combat, winning duels, and completing tactical objectives, they gradually unlock godlike combo skills such as Sweeping the Ranks, Armor-Piercing Execution, Formation Splitting, Gale Thrust, Whirlwind Dance, and Bone-Shattering Blow. These skills are never simple button presses — they interact deeply with attack rhythm, body positioning, and enemy formation. Seize a split-second opening in the chaos, chain together a smooth execution combo, and tear through the enemy line in an instant. From a fierce champion who charges ahead of the troops to a realm-expanding god of war who plucks an enemy commander’s head from among ten thousand soldiers as easily as reaching into a bag, you will witness their transformation in the grinding test of blood and iron.

Myriad Tactics, Free Skill Combinations

Every officer possesses a diverse, dedicated skill tree that covers both passive enhancements and active combat techniques. Passive abilities might permanently increase troop capacity, boost the damage of a specific unit type, or trigger a desperate last-stand state when all seems lost. Active combat skills include charge techniques, formation maneuvers, and stratagems, such as Iron Wall Defense, Blazing Arrow Formation, and Ambush Disruption. Based on your generals’ skill pools, you can freely mix and match them for different battle scenarios, crafting your own exclusive tactical school: will you have a lieutenant specialize in defense to grind the enemy down, or unleash a dual-core burst combo to obliterate the opposition? It all rests on your decision.

Blood-Soaked Growth, Ascending to a God of War

Through the crucible of countless brutal live battles, along with dedicated training fields, war academies, and combat simulation facilities, you will continuously hone your officers’ levels, base attributes, and skill proficiencies. Experience comes not only from kill counts, but also from completing high-stakes tactical assignments and scoring decisive kills on enemy commanders. You will witness them rise from mere captains leading a few hundred men, step by step, into great generals who hold entire regions, and finally into battlefield lynchpins who can shift the realm’s tides with their own strength. Their legend is written by your hand.

store_data.about_the_game:
SHARKS UNDERCOVER

You and your friends are sharks masquerading as dolphins to dupe and snatch the clueless fish who wander into your shop. Keep up the act and don't let those teeth show!

MANAGE YOUR SHOP

Stock the shelves with seashells and fresh seaweed, serve the locals, and keep the place spotless. Work your fins off to earn their trust - it’s the perfect cover for your shady business on the ocean floor!

GIVE WHALES A GLOW-UP

Win the trust of the ocean’s behemoths by buffing their bellies and fins until they sparkle. Gaining whale loyalty is your ticket to winning over the smaller fry!

THE PREDATOR'S SECRET KITCHEN

Snatch your own customers and turn them into gourmet delicacies in the hidden basement beneath your shop. Your shop is the bait, and they’re the main course!

THE FISH POLICE ARE WATCHING

Underwater cops are on your tail! Scrub the crime scene, lie through your teeth during interrogations, and don’t let the fuzz catch a whiff of what’s cooking in your kitchen.
