4712560.name: Pixel Darts: From Pub to Glory

store_data.about_the_game:
Pub Darts. 90s Arcade Soul.




This is what happens when a cozy English pub and a loud 90s arcade cabinet have a kid together.

Rival portraits. Dramatic VS screens. Big score flashes. Crowd pressure. Nicknames that should be illegal. And that one little voice in your head going: "Just one more leg."

Wrapped around all of it: a warm local, a throw you can pick up in thirty seconds, and a career built on finishing something your father never got to.

Easy to Pick Up. Not So Easy to Check Out.




Aim. Pull back. Flick. Release.

That's it. The throw is simple by design – but every visit still has timing, drift, pressure, release quality, and the quiet heartbreak of missing a double by three pixels.

A casual leg turns into a white-knuckle finish. One bad visit tanks a set. One perfect dart wakes the whole room up. You'll know the feeling.

501, Cricket, Shanghai, and Bermuda




Play the game you're in the mood for.

Classic X01 in 301, 501, and 701 – with Double In, Double Out, and best-of formats. Cricket for tactical scrapping. Shanghai for target-by-target focus. Bermuda when you want something with a bit more bite than another straight 501 leg.

Quick game before bed. Long couch session with the rankings on the line. One handheld round that somehow turns into five. The board's always ready.

Inherit the Pub. Finish What He Started.




Your dad left you The Lazy Trout.

A warm, slightly crooked English pub with loyal regulars, unpaid bills, and an upstairs office full of things that raise more questions than they answer. Old scorecards. Practice recordings. Trophies that don't mean what you assumed they meant.

As you climb from local hopeful to bigger stages, the pub shifts around you. Familiar faces react differently. Old rivalries come back around. And the Garrison family starts treating you like unfinished business.

It's a darts story about grief, inheritance, and slowly figuring out that what you were trying to prove was yours all along.

Build Your Own League




Want your own pub-season story from scratch?

Standalone League Mode lets you set up a custom season with your own players, venues, rules, standings, matchdays, and history. Build a local circuit, follow the table week by week, and watch proper rivalries form over a full season.

72 Opponents. All of Them a Problem.

Every rival comes with their own portrait, traits, rhythm, trash talk, and throwing style.

Some stay ice-cold under pressure. Some play to the crowd. Some won't stop talking. Some look harmless until treble 20 starts appearing like clockwork. You'll learn to read them – and you'll still get caught out.

Features

  • Tactile dart throwing: aim, pull back, flick, release
  • Classic X01: 301, 501, 701 – Double In, Double Out, best-of formats
  • Cricket, Shanghai, and Bermuda modes
  • Story-driven Career Mode with rankings, prize money, darts, trophies, practice, rival encounters, and pub events
  • A father-and-child story about legacy, self-doubt, and finishing what was left unfinished
  • Standalone League Mode: custom seasons, venues, rules, tables, matchdays, full season history
  • 72 opponents with portraits, traits, banter, and individual throwing styles
  • Quick Match and Practice for shorter sessions
  • Big-score moments for 140+, 160+, 170 checkouts, and 180s
  • Mouse/keyboard and gamepad support

store_data.about_the_game:
A sci-fi point-and-click adventure packed with brain-twisting puzzles and zero-gravity mystery. You are Max Reed, an ordinary guy who just won the trip of a lifetime: an all-expenses-paid stay at the galaxy’s most luxurious space hotel, Stellar Lux. The journey from Earth is smooth, the welcome is spectacular, and the views of the planet below are breathtaking. Then everything goes wrong. A catastrophic accident rips through the station. Systems fail, sections depressurize, and chaos erupts. Now the hotel that promised paradise has become a deadly trap floating 400 km above Earth. With limited oxygen, failing life support, and no help coming, Max must explore the sprawling, beautifully detailed space station, solve its many secrets, and find a way back home — before it’s too late.

Game Features

  • Classic 2D Point & Click Adventure with cartoony art and smooth animations

  • Up to 100 unique, hand-crafted puzzles — from logical riddles and inventory combinations to environmental puzzles, hacking terminals, and zero-gravity challenges

  • Rich sci-fi atmosphere — explore luxurious suites, robot servant restaurants, engineering decks, observation domes, and hidden maintenance areas

  • Non-linear exploration — multiple sections of the station can be tackled in different orders as you unlock new areas

  • Smart, fair puzzles — every puzzle has clear logic; no pixel hunting or guesswork

  • Compelling story with multiple endings and hidden secrets

Will you escape the Space Hotel? Every decision matters. Every item you pick up could be the key to survival. Every terminal you hack might reveal the truth behind the disaster… or just make things worse. Are you clever enough to survive the ultimate locked-room mystery — in space? Escape the Space Hotel — Coming to Steam

store_data.about_the_game:
Cold Transit is a peer-to-peer (P2P) multiplayer / singleplayer game of tag. Catch your friends in the public transport network, or try to escape in the maze of streets and connecting lines. 

The game is currently being developed, for now the following maps are available (with more to come):

  • Helsinki (Center)

  • Helsinki (Metropolitan Area)

  • The Nordic Countries

  • Cologne

Gameplay

  • As a Catcher, you must find the running player(s) by tracking them, as information about their movements are revealed to you. Every now and then, the Runners' current positions are revealed.

  • As a Runner, you must try to evade your captors by using every card at your disposal, and your wit. Use your stealthy options to sneak through the Catchers' grasp.

Multiplayer

The game is playable both with friends over peer-to-peer, or singleplayer against AI opponents. The P2P mode requires an online internet connection, and connects to our server to establish the initial connection between host and guest players, after that all network communication occurs only between the players.

NOTE! Players playing the demo version can play with players playing the full version, but will be limited to only the maps available in the demo, and a limited set of player avatars.

Joining / Creating a Game

Set your agent (player) name, and select your game mode:

  • Play Solo: singleplayer mode, play against the AI

  • Host Game: Create your own multiplayer game lobby, and share the access code with them

  • Join Game: Input the shared multiplayer access code to join another player's game lobby

In the lobby, set your appearance, and choose your role (Runner / Catcher). The host also adjusts the difficulty options for the session, before starting the game. Make sure to read the mission details to understand the game rules.

Playing the Game

After starting the game, each player takes their turn one at a time. To plan their moves, they have complete overview over the game board, and the tickets they currently possess to move around. To move between stations, players must choose to use an appropriate transport mode ticket, thus consuming it. The most recent player moves are displayed in the action log, allowing for the Catchers to determine the movements of the Runners. If a player runs out of tickets to move, they may use their turn to get a new set of tickets. The game ends once all Runners are caught (Catchers win), or the turn limit is reached (Runners win).

store_data.about_the_game:
The Empress Is Dead. Long Live The Empress!

One year has passed since the unfortunate accident of the late Empress.
Now, as the mourning period ends within the Forbidden City, the Emperor must appoint a new Empress.

This is your chance!

You have spent years as a mere consort of the Emperor... But now honor, wealth and power could all be yours! Play your cards wisely, earn the Emperor's favor and claim the throne for yourself!

But be careful — the other Consorts of the Emperor seek the very same prize.

Win the Emperors Heart and claim the Throne

Consorts of the Emperor is a secret identity card game in which players manipulate the deck to ensure they present the best gifts to the Emperor… while their rivals present the worst.

  • Manipulate the deck by placing your cards between upcoming cards.

  • Play powerful action cards to change the outcome of a round.

  • Predict where your rivals will play to outsmart them.

  • Keep your identity hidden until the perfect moment.

You are never alone in the Forbidden City!

  • Play online against other players!

  • Learn the game through a tutorial match against the computer.

  • Spectate matches as:

    • The Emperor — seeing only public information

    • The Eunuch — seeing every hidden role and secret play

Scheme against your rivals, outplay them and conquer the throne in Consorts of the Emperor!

store_data.about_the_game:
1.80 War God Slight Variant Game Introduction

1.80 War God Slight Variant is a side-scrolling action platformer set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Take control of a heavily armed mechanical dragon, tear through hordes of zombies and mutated bugs across desolate ruins, rescue survivors, and embark on an adrenaline-fueled fight for survival.

Core Gameplay: Mech Rampage, Side-Scrolling Combat

  • Control the Mechanical Dragon: Pilot a mechanical dragon equipped with heavy firepower, moving freely across desert battlefields and mowing down enemies with machine guns, flamethrowers, missiles, and more. Smooth movement and satisfying hit feedback make every battle a thrilling display of destruction.

  • Multi-Skill Combo Combat: The dragon comes with exclusive skills such as area-of-effect fireballs, piercing spikes, and tracking projectiles. Unlock more powerful abilities as you progress through levels, and combine them to pull off flashy combos against zombies, swarms of mutated bugs, and other foes.

  • Level Objective Challenges: Each level features kill goals and time limits. You must eliminate a set number of enemies within the time frame while protecting survivors, unlocking more levels and storylines, and taking on higher-difficulty wastelands.

Featured Systems: Post-Apocalyptic Wasteland & Mech Progression

  • Desolate Wasteland Environments: Set against barren deserts and abandoned ruins, complete with cacti, wrecked cars, and other post-apocalyptic elements. The atmosphere is both bleak and tense, capturing the unique feel of a world on the brink of collapse.

  • Dragon Upgrades & Progression: Use rewards and collected resources from levels to upgrade your mechanical dragon’s attack power, health, and skill strength. Unlock more powerful weapon attachments to craft your ultimate doomsday weapon, and take on even stronger foes with ease.

  • Survivor Rescue Gameplay: Encounter trapped survivors in levels; rescuing them grants bonus rewards and advances the story. Experience glimmers of humanity in the apocalypse, giving your journey more purpose.

Game Experience

In 1.80 War God Slight Variant, you will become the guardian of the wasteland, charging through gunfire aboard your steel dragon and tearing through enemy lines with overwhelming firepower. Satisfying combat, diverse skill combinations, and tense level challenges deliver an immersive side-scrolling action experience. Whether mowing down hordes with machine guns or unleashing full-screen barrages with all skills active, you’ll feel the raw power of apocalyptic mechs at every turn. Join now, pilot your mechanical dragon, and save the wasteland!

store_data.about_the_game:
WHAT IS INOCULATE

INOCULATE is a cinematic, 2.5D horror game, set in a collapsing Arctic research station currently under lockdown due to the appearance of an unknown entity that has started attacking and consuming facility personnel. You are put into the shoes of a Communication Officer, who was lucky enough to survive the initial chaos, but are now stuck inside the facility with that creature, with only one clear goal in mind: Survive and Escape.

EXPLORE A COLLAPSING FACILITY

Make your way through a facility that was once filled with the noises of machinery and people talking, but is now silent, with the only sounds being the siren in the background and screams echoing throughout the facility. 

THE HORROR WITHIN

You are not alone in the facility. Something else is roaming the hallways and laboratories, hunting for survivors to consume and assimilate into itself, becoming bigger, stronger, and more dangerous. Encounter and escape from the creatures, their designs inspired by movies such as 'The Thing.'

YOU CAN'T FIGHT BACK

You are not a soldier. And even if you were, you would not win in a direct fight. Hide, sneak, and stay out of sight if you want to survive. In the scenario where you get spotted: Run.

store_data.about_the_game:
Each match is a duel between two different playstyles: real-time first-person and top-down turn-based.

Keep the station safe and stop the infestation before it spreads out of control.

Monitor rooms for Alien activity, purify infected areas and repair broken systems through interactive minigames.

All while researching the Alien to eradicate its presence once and for all.

Spread through the facility from above, infesting rooms and sabotaging systems to push the station toward collapse.

Your actions follow a turn-based rhythm, forcing you to plan ahead, mislead and avoid retaliation.

Break systems at the right time to create pressure and bring the station to collapse or play it stealthy and take over through unchecked growth.

Every system on the station has a purpose, and every interaction changes the match.

As the Human, choosing what to repair can mean the difference between keeping control and losing valuable time.

As the Alien, every sabotage adds to the station’s collapse while creating problems the Human has to answer. Simple damage can be enough, but carefully planned failures can be much harder to recover from.

Features

  • Online 1v1 with Steam friends

  • Interactive minigames

  • Player-driven strategies

  • Stylized 3D lunar station

store_data.about_the_game:
Tuggin It is a physics-driven management game all about ships and cargo. Drive a lil tug boat, haul cargo with a crane, and manage your warehouse storage, all while taking on some side-jobs when you can!


Tugboat:

Tether your tug to other ships to pull them to where they need to be
Take sharp turns at speed to put out fires

Catch pirates and take them to the port authority!


Crane:

Connect your hook to cargo containers
Hoist cargo containers and load up your ship with sold cargo

Unload purchased cargo


Warehouse:

Manage your cargo storage
Buy/sell cargo ships in your fleet

Unlock upgrades for your tug and warehouse via a reputation system

Purchase connections with corporations, to allow direct selling of cargo to them

Earn XP with these corporations to increase the profit percentage of sales

Equip cosmetic items and customize your tug boat!

Tuggin It features a simulated economy where the prices of cargo types rise and fall over time, keep an eye on it or set price alerts to make sure you buy low and sell high!


Take on side-jobs:

  • Unload cargo from an NPC ship

  • Recover cargo lost at sea

  • Put out fires on NPC ships

  • Deliver cargo to nearby locations

  • Place buoys at designated planes

  • Transfer NPC ships from one lane of traffic to another

  • Catch pirates!

And more to be added soon!

Workshop support:

A fully integrated workshop to share and subscribe to cosmetic items to equip on your tugboat, so you're always tuggin it in style!

store_data.about_the_game:
《Fight Again: Ultimate Gear +255》Game Introduction

《Fight Again: Ultimate Gear +255》 is a retro casual game centered on idle progression and stat growth. With easy auto-play gameplay paired with the classic "Ultimate Gear" upgrade system, you’ll relive the thrill of skyrocketing stats and one-hit kills—embark on a laid-back growth journey without complicated controls.

Core Gameplay: Auto Combat & Skyrocketing Stats

  • Fully Idle Auto Combat: Enter the Trial Grounds to activate auto-combat. Your character will progress through stages and attack enemies automatically, even accumulating rewards while you’re offline. No constant operations required—log in anytime to claim your spoils and steadily advance your progression.

  • Uncapped Stat Enhancement: From Attack Power and HP to HP Regeneration, all attributes can be upgraded without limits. Combined with the iconic "+255" Ultimate Gear system, your power will surge nonstop. One-shot enemies, clear entire screens at once, and experience the ultimate thrill of stat domination.

  • Trial Stage Challenges: Start at Trial Grounds 1-1 and conquer hundreds of stages. Every level grants coins, materials, and unlocks higher progression caps. As you advance, enemies grow stronger—take on tougher trials to unlock even richer resources for your upgrades.

Featured Systems: Classic Progression, Rich Gameplay

  • Multi-Dimensional Growth System: Five core systems support your development: Character, Skills, Pets, Dungeons, and Summoning. Upgrade your character’s base stats, unlock more powerful skills, gain bonus effects with pets, farm rare materials in dungeons, and summon powerful allies—craft your unique progression path.

  • Casual Reward Systems: A full suite of daily rewards awaits: 7-Day Check-In, Lucky Spin, and Daily Tasks. Complete simple objectives to earn coins, diamonds, and enhancement materials, ensuring your progression never stalls—even free-to-play players can keep up easily.

  • Retro Casual Atmosphere: With fresh cartoon-style art and classic idle game UI design, there’s no complicated story or controls—just pure stat growth and satisfying stage clears, recapturing the simple joy of old-school progression games.

Game Experience

In 《Fight Again: Ultimate Gear +255》, you’ll start as a basic character and build your way to a powerhouse with "+255" Ultimate Gear stats through auto-combat and upgrades. There’s no complex gameplay or intense competition—only the satisfying rush of rising stats and the thrill of wiping out entire screens of enemies. Whether you’re logging in for a quick session to collect rewards or leaving the game idle to progress passively, you’ll find pure, uncomplicated fun. Join now and begin your journey to Ultimate Gear mastery!

store_data.about_the_game:
Pulsewave

A geometric twin-stick arena shooter built on speed, precision, and decisions. No textures, no bloat — just pure neon and the line between you and your next shot.

Three modes, one arena

  • ARENA — Classic deathmatch. First to the kill cap wins. Brutal, fast, decisive.

  • CAPTURE THE PULSE — Hold the energy orb to bank points. Get hit, lose it, race back to the center. First to 30 takes the match.

  • PAINT WAR — Each kill paints the floor in your color. Whoever covers more territory when the timer ends wins the war.

Build your fighter

A 91-node skill tree across 5 archetype branches — Vanguard, Anchor, Sharpshooter, Phaser, Sustainer. Path-from-root allocation. Notable nodes that change how you play. One keystone you commit to. Respec costs SURGE — rebuild any time.

Free to play, fair to fight

Pulsewave is free to play. Cosmetics — auras and trails — are the only thing premium currency buys. No pay-to-win. Your hitbox never changes regardless of what you wear. Skill is the only unlock that matters.

Built different

  • Code-rendered geometric graphics — runs on a potato, looks sharp on a 4K

  • Difficulty scaling from EASY to BRUTAL

  • XP-based progression with skill points across difficulty tiers

  • Auto-updating launcher with asset pack split for fast patches

Pulsewave is currently in active development. Wishlist now to follow updates and new modes coming soon.

store_data.about_the_game:
Loop Miner

Deep beneath the dark underground, a small mole miner begins an endless journey of excavation.

Loop Miner is a mining incremental game where you gather resources, sell minerals, collect artifacts, and push deeper into the mine.
At first, all you have is a tiny pickaxe — but with every mining loop, the mole grows stronger, and the mine reveals greater treasures and new possibilities.

Gather resources with simple controls, choose upgrades, and improve your efficiency.
Even when one loop ends, your progression never stops.
Each new run lets you go faster, deeper, and farther than before.

Join the little mole miner and dig toward the bottom of the endless mine.

Game Features

Endless Mining Progression

Dig through the mine, gather resources, and grow your mole miner.
The more you repeat the cycle, the faster your mining speed and profits become, allowing you to reach deeper areas.

Simple Yet Addictive Incremental Gameplay

Focused on the core fun of mining, selling, and upgrading without complicated controls.
Make progress even in short play sessions, and achieve massive efficiency gains the longer you play.

Upgrade the Mole Miner’s Equipment

Enhance your pickaxe, turrets, drones, mining abilities, and more to mine resources faster and more efficiently.
Your upgrade choices directly affect your growth speed.

Loop System That Grows Stronger Every Run

Even when a mining expedition ends, your progression continues.
Start each new loop stronger than before and challenge even deeper mines.

Adorable Mole Miner and Ever-Deeper Mines

Explore the mine alongside a small but hardworking mole miner.
The deeper you go, the more valuable resources and new goals await you.

In the quiet aftermath of high school graduation, one final celebration awaits. A simple walk through sunlit streets leads to an open countryside, where a beautiful river flows under the blue sky. Beyond it lies her friend’s house in a distant village — the perfect escape for one unforgettable night.

store_data.about_the_game:
Story Background

In a world struck by a plague, once infected, humans turn into monsters. Just as everything is plunged into despair, a legend emerges — the Still Train.

If you survive and manage to reach it, you will find hope for survival. It sounds unbelievable.

You will play as an adult woman named Luna Lexus. After a shooting incident, Luna loses her memory. When she opens her eyes again, she finds herself, as the last survivor of this world, aboard a mysterious train. What she must do next, with the help of the conductor Diqiu, is return to the world ravaged by monsters and plague — and recover her lost memories.

Character Introduction

  • Luna Lexus (Protagonist)

A classic upbeat protagonist you’d find in any typical story — so how come she ended up losing her memory? A bit clumsy, isn’t she…

She claims she wants to bring something fresh to the audience, but the protagonist doesn’t seem willing to reveal much else about herself. Looks like she’s aiming to keep an air of mystery.

---

  • Diqiu (Train Conductor)

A calm and reliable conductor, mostly expressionless — possibly a case of facial paralysis. It would probably be amusing if someone could get him to show another expression.

The type who prefers to act directly rather than talk or think things through. And his love for combat seems genuine.

Despite that hairstyle, his right eye isn’t blind — seems like he’s just making a fashion statement.

Controls

Use the arrow keys to move the character. Press ESC / X to open the menu. Press Space to investigate / interact with NPCs.

This game requires manual saving.

store_data.about_the_game:
This game was born from an image that has become a part of internet culture — a lone penguin leaving its colony and walking into the endless icy wastelands toward gigantic, almost unreachable mountain peaks. Online, this image is often seen as a symbol of nihilism, loneliness, or a meaningless journey toward death. But the game is built on a completely different interpretation of that story.

There will always be voices around you trying to pull you back: some out of fear, others out of envy, and others simply because they themselves stopped believing in something greater long ago.

But can you make it through all that pressure, refuse to let other people’s words become your own thoughts, and still keep moving forward — toward what you truly want?

But can you keep going even when dangers, mistakes, and moments lie ahead where the whole world seems to be convincing you to stop?

If the answer is yes — then go. Don’t give up. Find the strength within yourself to keep moving forward, even if the unknown awaits you, even if you are afraid. Only you are meant to live your life, not someone else.

The story becomes not a tale about death or nihilism, but a reflection on human life itself. About why people leave their «colonies», why they strive toward impossible peaks, and what exactly drives them to continue the journey, even when all that surrounds them is cold and emptiness.

store_data.about_the_game:
Renegades is a turn-based party card battler about five fugitives trying to cross a kingdom that has decided people like them should disappear.

The Kingdom of Valdris has outlawed unsanctioned magic. The old orders have bent, the roads have gone dark, and the people who once held the frontier together are being hunted. Your party did not set out to save the world. They defected, survived, and kept walking.

Choose three characters for each battle. Each has their own deck, hand, items, defenses, and role in the fight. Every turn, play cards drawn from the deck of your characters in combat, spend your actions carefully, then watch the round resolve: your party first, enemies second. Complete optional objectives to win rewards in the form of more power or better loot.

Key Features

  • Multi-character card tactics- Fight with 3 active characters from a roster of 5, each with an independent deck and tactical identity.

  • Deterministic turn resolution - Plan your round, play cards in any order, then weather the enemy response.

  • Distinct party roles - Hold the line with Hyperion, heal and break enemies with Solyn, set traps with Faide, mark and detonate with Luciana, and turn blood into power with Arinas.

  • A world map built around visible choices - Explore the Greenveil Forest, uncover Points of Interest, face roaming threats, and decide which roads are worth the risk.

  • Original music - that captures the spirit of battle and the Renegades world.

  • Narrative consequences with mechanical weight - Events, defeats, and hard choices can leave temporary emotion cards in your deck: Hope, Shame, Vengeance, Grief, and more.

  • Character growth through mastery - Invest in character-specific mastery lines to unlock new cards, passives, and stronger tactical identities.

  • Gear, consumables, and battle rewards - Shape your loadouts between fights and earn bonuses for clean victories, risky plays, and careful execution.

This is a game about tactics under pressure, trust earned slowly, and the small decisions people make when every road leads north.

  • Original music - that captures the spirit of battle and the Renegades world.

  • Narrative consequences with mechanical weight - Events, defeats, and hard choices can leave temporary emotion cards in your deck: Hope, Shame, Vengeance, Grief, and more.

  • Character growth through mastery - Invest in character-specific mastery lines to unlock new cards, passives, and stronger tactical identities.

  • Gear, consumables, and battle rewards - Shape your loadouts between fights and earn bonuses for clean victories, risky plays, and careful execution.

This is a game about tactics under pressure, trust earned slowly, and the small decisions people make when every road leads north.
store_data.short_description: Renegades is a party RPG with deckbuilding combat: lead five hunted heroes, each with unique mechanics and their own deck, choose three for each fight, and survive a kingdom coming apart through tactical, story-driven battles.

Return to the long-lost world of the Mystic Diary series!

When Charlotte receives a mysterious invitation to her uncle Victor’s manor, she expects her visit to bring up fond memories but instead finds only danger. Explore beautifully detailed scenes of the manor and its surrounding area, through ancient forests, forgotten villages, and enchanted ruins filled with clues from the past. Dive into a spellbinding tale that mixes mystery, magic, and adventure in every scene!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

store_data.about_the_game:
Colorland Friends is a gentle and engaging educational game designed to help young children learn and recognize colors through play.

The game is structured into three main levels, each consisting of three interactive stages, gradually building the child’s understanding of colors.

Across the experience, children are introduced to a total of ten essential colors:
- Level 1: Introduces 4 basic colors
- Level 2: Introduces 4 additional colors
- Level 3: Reinforces all 10 colors together

Stage 1 – Learning
In this stage, children are introduced to colors through friendly cartoon characters.
- Five different characters appear, all sharing the same color
- This repeats for each color in the level
- Then, each character is shown again in multiple colors
This helps children understand that color is a property that can change, while the object remains the same.

Stage 2 – Interaction
Children are encouraged to actively participate.
- A colored character appears on screen
- A palette of colors is displayed
- The child selects the matching color
This stage reinforces recognition through hands-on learning and repetition.

Stage 3 – Relaxation & Reward
After learning and testing, children enjoy a calm and rewarding moment.
- Milo, the friendly monkey host, appears in a short animation
- He walks through the environment, creating a relaxing transition
- At the end of the level, Milo reaches his home, giving a warm sense of comfort and completion

Core Experience
Colorland Friends combines learning, interaction, and relaxation to create a balanced experience that keeps children engaged while building confidence in color recognition.

Designed for children aged 3–6.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build haunted theme parks and supervise ghosts in this cozy afterlife sim. Construct fun attractions, manage resources, recruit cute ghosts and haunt the park in order to spook and delight the guests!

As the newly hired ghost manager of Haunted Attractions, you'll find yourself learning the most efficient way to build new theme parks. While there are many goals to achieve, there's no way to fail.

Recruit new ghosts with special abilities! Do you want to recruit Bandit, the crafty raccoon ghost who comes with a handy discount? Perhaps Callie, the bunny ghost who turns all the spooky resources they collect into fun ones. Or maybe you just think the dog ghost Wishbone is just too cute to pass up. (You can worry about their ability later.)

Choose which attractions to build in your new theme park. Purchase upgrades for them so they can produce more resources and reach their full potential.

Select which ghosts haunt which attractions to maximize your resources gained and get what you need to build what you have planned next!

It's a lot of work building theme parks! Take some time to hang out in the lounge, grab a warm drink and talk to your new ghost friends.

GeneWorld is a procedural multiplayer action RPG where players travel through infinite worlds filled with portals, corrupted creatures, hidden dimensions, and unpredictable expeditions.

Every journey creates a new story.

the stranger the universe becomes.

store_data.about_the_game:
In Goof Off, you play as creatures called Goofs who have decided to go to a strange underground warehouse and fight it out. 

Pick up weapons and start readying for a battle you won't forget!

Face your opponents with more than 50 Weapons

  • Pull out a strangely realistic-looking gun to shoot down your foes

  • Steal your opponent's weapon by grabbing it with a plunger

  • Set up mines to lock off areas of the maps

  • Fire lasers through walls to stop your cowardly foe from running away

  • And since Goofs are secretly amebas, you can send them flying at your enemies, and gain victory

Change your play style with costumes!

Costume crates are another type of crate that will spawn in the underground warehouse, which will boost your abilities in wacky ways!

  • The Bunny will leap into the sky and avoid its enemy's fire

  • Tanks have increased Vitality and will not fall

  • The Wampire(yes, with a W) will drain all life force from anyone it attacks

And more costumes to help Goof Off!

You may also find yourself located in unique places underground, with many obstacles

  • Jump over lava and try not to fry yourself

  • Spikes that are pointy. Just a bit.

  • Water-filled rooms, but worry not, Goofs don't need oxygen

Find your way around and use these traps to help succeed in victory!

Note:

  • You can play with a mix of both keyboard and controllers, so have fun!

  • There is no true single-player option in Goof Off, so bring more people to goof off with you!

store_data.about_the_game:
**"If you're out of luck, cheat your way to victory!"**

Blosharper is a hardcore roguelike deckbuilder built upon the foundation of 'Hwatu'—a traditional Korean card game. Burdened by a crushing, insurmountable debt, you find yourself trapped in a deadly underground gambling den. There is only one way out: survive the ever-escalating deathmatches and pay off what you owe.

But playing fair won't save you here. You must unlock, combine, and execute dozens of powerful "Skills" (Cheats) to break the system!

**🔥 Key Features**

* **Breath-taking Betting:** Go or Stop? Will you raise the stakes or walk away? If you're scared, fold!

* **Deceptive Deckbuilding:** Layer over 100 bizarre and powerful "cheat" skills on top of traditional Hwatu hands to craft your ultimate scam build.

* **High-Stakes Risks:** Get caught cheating, and the penalty is severe! Walk a tightrope risking your HP and chips.

* **Black Market & Inflation:** Prices skyrocket, and your debt compounds with interest. Survive the constant threat of bankruptcy!

* **The Four Stats of a Sharp:** Luck, Bluff, Guts, and Wit. Upgrade these talents to increase your cheating success rate and dominate the table!

* **Lethal Boss Fights:** Every 4 rounds, ruthless bosses armed with wicked gimmicks will test your limits.

* **Collections & Hidden Achievements:** Unlock diverse Hwatu card themes and uncover hidden achievements for endless replayability!

* **Infinite Strategies, Massive Combos:** A scoring system where card hands and cheat skills multiply together exponentially. The hand you push is the right answer.

Will you defeat The Lender and see the sunlight once again?

store_data.about_the_game:
Learn Mahjong From an Interactable Videotape

At first, this is a fantasy arcade mahjong tutorial.

The tape teaches you how to read tiles, form hands, understand waits, watch discards, and win your first match against a computer opponent.

But after the lesson ends, the tape keeps going.

Real Mahjong, Now Roguelike

You'll quickly transfer your mahjong skills into the roguelike challenge. It is still based on real mahjong rules, but now you can build your tile set, find synergies, win more, and win big.

Build Around Real Mahjong Hands

Every run starts from the language of mahjong: suits, honors, sequences, triplets, pairs, waits, calls, and scoring patterns.

Then the roguelike layer starts bending the lesson.

Add more of the tiles you want. Remove tiles that slow you down. Strengthen certain suits, boost honor tiles, reward triplets, support pairs, or build toward rare patterns. A small change to your inventory can turn a normal hand into the start of something much bigger.

Rewind the Tape

When a round goes wrong, rewind the tape and try another take.

Maybe your opponent wins before you. Maybe your hand wins, but not by enough. Maybe you can already clear the round, but you saw a better hand hiding a few turns back.

Rewinding lets you return to an earlier point in the recording, use what you learned, and play the hand differently. It is not only a safety net. It is part of how you build bigger wins.

Find Synergies in the Static

Between matches, choose upgrades that change how your run develops.

  • Add or remove tiles from your set

  • Boost specific patterns

  • Pick Sticker items that reward your preferred style of play

  • Use arcade-style Command items to change the game

  • Discover powerful modchips to break the rules

A Tutorial With Something Underneath

This tape looks like a bright arcade mahjong tutorial, but the recording seems to have something underneath.

Keep playing.

Keep rewinding.

Key Features

  • Learn real mahjong through an interactive tutorial structure

  • Play mahjong hands against a computer opponent running an advanced mahjong algorithm

  • Turn mahjong knowledge into roguelike builds and synergies

  • Rewind the tape to replay key moments and find better takes

  • Discover secrets inside a strange arcade videotape

store_data.about_the_game:
《女皇的绝色男宠》是一款以唯美国风为背景的女性向角色扮演养成游戏。‌‌

玩家将扮演青鸾国的公主，在临危受命成为女王后，肩负起发展壮大国家的重任，周旋于各方势力之间，最终开创属于自己的盛世。‌‌

游戏核心特色

‌1. 沉浸式剧情与角色互动‌

游戏拥有跌宕起伏的主线剧情与丰富的支线选择，涵盖甜宠、权谋、虐恋等多种情感走向，玩家的抉择将影响故事进程与结局。‌‌

游戏中邂逅超过百位性格迥异的角色，包括身世神秘的侍从伽蓝、别扭单纯的相府公子长孙子安、温柔深情的竹马谢语花、算无遗策的军师洛飞卿以及强势霸道的敌国皇子赫连钰等。‌‌

每位角色都有专属剧情与情感线，玩家可通过互动深入了解其背景故事，建立深度羁绊。‌‌

‌2. 唯美国风与自由穿搭‌

游戏采用超高精度的国风立绘，构建了一个华丽梦幻的东方世界。‌‌

服饰系统支持多部位拆分，玩家可自由搭配上千种风格的华裳，并可通过挑战副本获取图纸，亲手制作喜爱的服饰，享受设计与换装的双重乐趣。‌‌

‌3. 多元融合的养成玩法‌

‌成长与权谋‌：玩家需从公主一步步成长为一代女帝，在宫廷与权谋斗争中做出决策，主宰自己的命运。‌‌

‌模拟经营‌：玩家可扩展土地、建造工坊、生产商品并进行贸易通商，将初始荒芜的皇城经营成繁荣的国都。‌‌

‌宗族传承‌：游戏包含子女养成系统，玩家可对子女进行教导培养，待其成年后为其指婚，延续宗族血脉。‌‌

‌4. 丰富的血统与收集系统‌

游戏引入了独特的“血统”设定，拥有诸子百家、节气、食神、妖魔天使等数十种不同血统的侍臣和羽卫可供收集与培养，每种血统都关联着独特的剧情与能力。‌‌

Before the end of the world, you died.

But Stella refused to accept such an ending.

So in another timeline of the world, you are resurrected, to begin your battle once again.

Clash steel with steel in intense card-based duels

An intuitive combat system built around attacking and defending with cards, where every exchange feels direct and tactical.

Break through enemy defenses with different builds:a relentless flurry of strikes, a single overwhelming blow, or bleeding damage that cannot be blocked — the choice is yours.

Freely Arrange Your Attacks and Defenses

Place or withdraw cards at any time, and freely rearrange their order during battle.

Exploit enemy weaknesses, pierce through their defenses, or brace against devastating attacks with precise timing.

Clear and Instant Damage Preview

No tedious math required.

Every action immediately shows its impact on the final outcome, allowing you to focus entirely on strategy and decision-making.

Resist Corruption and Curses

The hero must battle not only the curses of the outside world, but also the torment within.

Grow Stronger Before Sunset

Each day consists of a limited deck of encounters.

Battle? Recover? Enhance your power?

Make your choices carefully, and face the Lord at sunset in a duel to the death.

Enemies Filled with Tension and Personality

Every enemy features unique combat mechanics and exclusive cards.

Storytelling is woven directly into both the illustrations and gameplay systems.

More Content and Features Are Still in Development

Feedback and discussion are always welcome.

Let’s create an even better game together.

store_data.about_the_game:
By day, this is a light-drinks bookstore.

By night, beneath the deep sea, we journey to the end of dreams.

Talk Insomnia is a visual novel that blends suspenseful weird tales with mixology. You play as Ming, a bookstore staff member who prepares drinks for guests during the day and delves into their stories at night. With the warmth of a single drink, you draw out the secrets buried deep in their hearts.

As for the phone legend entwined with every guest—is it the greed of those who make wishes, or a trap set by an imitator? Is it a natural curse, or the work of a corrupted heart? Who is the true culprit behind the legend?

Let us piece together the truth hidden beneath all the lies, in the space between dreams and reality.

Welcome to the deep sea of the subconscious. In dreams—no one can lie.

The Abyss Bookstore Legend Incident is about to begin.

The player takes on the role of Ming, a bookstore clerk, who guides guests into their subconscious dreams by mixing a special drink called "Abyss".

Within the dreams, collaborators possess special abilities — sensing emotions, detecting lies, forcing follow-up questions, rewinding and resetting, and more.

Players must gather clues during the day and solve mysteries in dreams at night, uncovering the truth through layer after layer of twists. Mixing drinks is not just a backdrop setting, but a core mechanic that runs throughout both the narrative and the gameplay.

The story revolves around a phone-based urban legend involving wishes and their costs, exploring the disconnect between greed, desire, and the sense of happiness.

Behind every guest lies a mysterious legend, and behind every legend lies the human heart.

"In the late-night phone booth, a voice asks you what wish you want to fulfill." The legend is not a natural disaster, but a man-made one. An imitator plays with people's hearts by exploiting the rules, and the true culprit is hiding among the guests.

As players connect the cases, they must also confront their own memories and the mystery of their identity, ultimately revealing the mastermind behind the legend.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Deep Shift is an atmospheric underwater station simulation game that combines maintenance, repair, exploration, and the gradual restoration of a forgotten deep-sea facility.

You are transported to the station by trawler and lowered deep beneath the ocean surface in a diving bell. Far below the waves, a massive aging underwater facility waits in complete silence — damaged, partially flooded, without power in many areas, and barely operational.

You take over the shift of a former technician who already abandoned the station. At the beginning, only a small section of the facility is accessible. Your quarters, basic tools, a workbench, and an old diving suit become your starting point. From there, you slowly bring the station back to life piece by piece.

Repair damaged systems, restore power, water, oxygen, and pressure systems, seal leaks, remove corrosion, clean contaminated areas, and reopen sealed sections of the station. Many failures require more than simple repairs — heavily damaged components must be completely replaced.

Major maintenance work requires precise procedures: water or power systems must first be shut down, damaged pipe segments removed with a grinder, and new physical replacement parts transported, installed, and welded or secured into place.

As the facility is restored, new sections of the station become accessible, including flooded corridors, engineering sectors, maintenance shafts, and exterior underwater areas. Equipped with your diving suit, you venture into the dark depths of the ocean to perform external repairs and recover lost parts of the station.

Every repaired system visibly changes the station. Dark rooms come back to life, machinery powers up, lights return, and more sections of the facility become operational again.

Later in the game, companies and research teams begin using parts of the station for their own operations. New crews arrive in supply diving bells, establish work areas, and create new maintenance jobs, damage, dirt, and technical problems that require constant upkeep.

Features

  • Atmospheric underwater station setting

  • Repair, maintenance, and cleaning systems

  • Power, water, pressure, and oxygen management

  • Physical tools and interactive repairs

  • Replacement of damaged pipe segments and modules

  • Transport and installation of physical replacement parts

  • Flooded and unlockable station areas

  • EVA and underwater exterior sections

  • Dynamic maintenance and station tasks

  • Immersive first-person gameplay

  • Deep-sea atmosphere and environmental storytelling

  • Gradual restoration and expansion of the station

  • Companies, research teams, and new work areas in the midgame

  • Slow-paced, immersive, and relaxing gameplay experience

Beyond the station walls, the ocean waits in complete darkness. Deep beneath the surface, the future of the station depends on your work.

store_data.about_the_game:
Вот как всё работает.

Ты приходишь в себя в чужом теле. Или не в чужом? Вокруг – ещё не сложившаяся Русь, 862 год. Тебя встречают как Рюрика. Но ты не помнишь ни своего настоящего имени, ни откуда взялся. Только смутные образы. И странное чувство: некоторые вещи ты знаешь… но не должен.

Это игра не про суперспособности и не про прыжки во времени. Она про потерянную память и живую историю, за которой спрятаны ответы.

ДВЕ ИСТОРИИ В ОДНОЙ.

Первая – настоящая. Летописи, археология, призвание варягов, Новгород, первые князья. Всё по фактам. Здесь нет места богам и духам. Но иногда ты замечаешь то, чего не видят другие. Слышишь то, чего ещё не сказали. Будто кто-то тихо подсказывает.

Вторая – твоя личная. Кто ты? Почему не помнишь прошлого? И откуда в голове обрывки того, чего ещё не случилось? Это похоже на мистику, но мистики здесь нет. Это что-то другое. Что-то, что не ломает историю, но объясняет, почему ты в ней оказался.

СМЕРТЬ – НЕ КОНЕЦ, А НОВЫЙ КРУГ.

Умер? Начни заново. Мир изменится: появятся фразы, которых раньше не было, и варианты, мимо которых ты прошёл. Разное прохождение – разные пути. Каждая смерть оставляет след.

ВСЕМ НЕ УГОДИШЬ – И ЭТО НОРМАЛЬНО.

Дружина ждёт добычи. Народ – мира. Кочевники – твоей головы. Коротко – ДНК. Поднимаешь одних – другие тихо ненавидят. Живи с этим.

ТВОЙ ХАРАКТЕР – НЕ ПРОСТО ЦИФРЫ.

Смелость, Интеллект, Любопытство, Авторитет. Коротко – СИЛА. Они растут не в меню, а от твоих слов и поступков. Каждая прокачка открывает новые варианты. А есть и скрытые пути – с первого раза не заметишь.

МОЖНО ОТДОХНУТЬ.

Устал править и распутывать свою память? Сыграй в местную карточную игру. Но она откроется только самым любопытным.

ТАИНСТВЕННЫЕ ПРЕДМЕТЫ.

Попадаются странные камни. Что-то в них есть такое, что не объяснишь ни поверьями, ни случайностью. Может, ключ к тому, кто ты на самом деле.

ИНТЕРАКТИВНАЯ КАРТА.

Реки, города, вождества. Можно дипломатией. Можно войной. Решаешь только ты. Но история не дремлет – за ошибки она наказывает. Хотя и обмануть её можно.

И МНОГОЕ ДРУГОЕ...

store_data.about_the_game:
Command your party. Conquer the dungeon together.

Rally the Parties is a semi-real-time tactical RPG where time only flows while your active character is acting. You direct the battle through high-level orders, and your party members act autonomously based on their assigned policies. You can switch between characters at any time to take direct control of any role.
Melee, ranged, support, lockdown, flanking — seven character classes each bring unique combat techniques, and your tactical options shift dramatically depending on how you combine them. Orchestrating synergy between party members is the key to success.

Features

  • Semi-real-time combat: Time only advances while your character is acting — a distinctive system that lets you think carefully before committing to your next move.
  • Seven classes, seven roles: Swordfighter, Axe Warrior, Scout, Archer, Fire Mage, Water Mage, and Healer. Each has its own attack range and special abilities, and the way you mix them reshapes your strategy.
  • Lead through directives: Issue party-wide orders such as Attack, Defend, Rally, or Retreat. Your companions interpret your intent and act on their own judgment.
  • Recruit and expand: Talk to NPCs you encounter in the dungeon and build a party of up to eight. Different combinations open up entirely different approaches.
  • Multiple parties exploring at once: You're not the only group in the dungeon — several NPC parties roam and explore on their own. Sometimes you cooperate, sometimes you compete; their presence gives the adventure life and unpredictability.
  • Roguelike stakes: One defeat ends the run. Every attempt invites you to rethink your party, equipment, and tactics on the path to the Demon Lord at the deepest floor.

Screenshots

Origins

In my youth, I was struck by Ali Baba (Starcraft, 1985) — an RPG where you switched between multiple characters as you played — and was further captivated by the arcade game Gain Ground (Sega, 1988), which built its design around the strategic use of distinct characters with unique abilities. That sense of fascination has never faded.
In the years since, tactical RPGs and MMORPGs flourished, and games featuring parties of cooperating characters became commonplace. But none of them quite captured what I was looking for. The ideal game system remained a recurring daydream — never something that felt within reach to actually build.
Then came the recent rise of generative AI, which suddenly made it possible for an individual to produce a game at a quality previously requiring a full studio. Sensing that this might be the last opportunity to bring a long-held idea to life, I finally began development. Rally the Parties is the result.

Who this game is for / About Early Access

This game is made for players who:
  • Enjoy game systems built around strategically managing multiple characters
  • Are drawn to experimental games that step outside familiar genre conventions
  • Are looking for a gameplay experience they haven't had before
Rally the Parties launches in Early Access. The core combat system, party formation, dungeon exploration, and the full path to the Demon Lord battle are all in place — even now, the game offers a complete, self-contained experience. Ongoing balance refinement, additional content, and UI/UX improvements are planned. Please see the "About This Early Access Game" section below for details.

store_data.about_the_game:
A world held together by old oaths and older wounds.

IconicQuest is a pixel-art, top-down MMORPG built for people who remember when the genre respected your time. Real-time skill-based combat. A shared persistent world. Loot that means something. No pay-to-win, no auto-battle, no skip button. Built solo, in the open, by one developer.

Combat you have to actually play.

You swing, they swing back. Accuracy ratings, evasion, weapon velocity tiers, attack speed — every hit is calculated, every miss is yours to learn from. Different mob families have different patterns. You learn their patterns. You stop dying as much. That's the game working correctly.

Position matters. Buffs matter. Preparation matters.

A world with places that mean something.

Teon Town sits at the center of four roads. Each one leads somewhere specific — a wasteland where the creatures have started moving with purpose, a frozen north sealed by an inscription someone chiseled out, a half-buried fortress where a watcher named Gareth doesn't say much.

You find things by going places. Every landmark was put there for a reason the world has mostly forgotten. Some of those reasons are still waiting.

Gear that means something.

No junk drops. No rarity inflation. When a weapon drops, you remember it. Crafting requires a recipe scroll, the right materials, and the right station. Enchant your gear from +1 to +16 — succeed and it gets stronger and starts to glow, fail and you don't.

You'll use the same sword for a long time. That's not a flaw. That's the point.

Real multiplayer. Not singleplayer with online tacked on.

A shared persistent world. Party system. Player nameplates. Open-world grinding zones. Group dungeons. PvP. The kind of MMO where the people around you are people, not bots, and where going somewhere dangerous together is an agreement, not a matchmaking queue.

The promise.

  • No pay-to-win, ever. Cosmetics and convenience only. Power is earned in the world.

  • Real-time, skill-driven combat. No auto-play, no skip buttons.

  • Loot has weight. No junk drops, every item earns its slot, the economy is real.

  • A world worth exploring. Hand-placed, not procedural. Every road leads somewhere.

  • Built alone, in the open. By someone who has spent 22 years playing MMOs and decided the game they wanted didn't exist yet.

Early Access: what you'll find at launch.

  • Real-time combat with multiple mob families and distinct archetypes

  • Open-world exploration with hand-placed zones, towns, and dungeons

  • A starting class system with branching specializations

  • Station-based crafting (anvil, workbench, campfire) with recipe scrolls dropped from mobs

  • Gathering: mining, with herbalism, woodcutting, and fishing on the roadmap

  • Enchanting from +1 to +16 with visible glow tiers and risk of failure

  • Full party system with shared persistent world and player nameplates

  • PvP in designated open-world zones

  • Group dungeons including the Temple of Ice and Fire

  • Quest system with kill, collect, deliver, and dialogue objectives

  • Travel Master NPCs for fast travel between zones you've discovered on foot

Why Early Access.

IconicQuest is built by one developer. Early Access is how the world grows next: more zones, more dungeons, more classes, more depth — built with the people playing it, not in a vacuum. The roadmap is public. The Discord is where it happens first. If you want an MMO that respects your time and your wallet, this is where to start.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Gavel Falls in Gallows & Gold

Sentence the guilty and spare the innocent—or do the opposite. Set in a grim medieval era, Gallows & Gold is a hand-etched judgment simulator where your verdicts carry the weight of life and death. Navigate corruption, law, and your own morality in a world crafted entirely in pen and ink.

The Gavel is Yours.

The King is fading, the treasury is dry, and the people are hungry. You have been appointed to the High Court of Anglia—not to find the truth, but to maintain the peace. In a kingdom where the "King’s Rot" consumes the crown and the Church demands its pound of flesh, justice is a luxury the realm can barely afford.

Key Features

The Weight of Judgment: Every morning, the doors creak open to reveal a new soul seeking mercy or a new villain deserving of the rope. You are the final arbiter. No decision is easy. Review evidence, listen to pleas, and weigh the testimonies of the desperate. Every sentence you scrawl reshapes the kingdom's future—affecting the economy, public order, and your own standing with the crown.

Based on Real History: Preside over trials inspired by actual medieval court records. From frantic farmers accusing their livestock of witchcraft to where pigs were prosecuted for murder, no two cases are the same. You will face the same bizarre dilemmas as judges of the Middle Ages.

Judge the absurd & The Grim: 

Analyse the Evidence: Sift through the Evidence Ledger to find the truth, or ignore it entirely if the bribe is high enough.

Declare the Sentence: One click decides it all. Whether you decide the convict is innocent or guilty, the question is do you let them free or at what length do you punish the guilty? You decide.

The Impossible Balance

Your bench is a scales of three weights: The Crown, The Church, and The Commoners.

 Rule for the King to keep your head, even if the laws grow more erratic.

 Rule for the Priest to keep the Church’s favour, or risk being branded a heretic yourself.

 Rule for the People to stop the city from burning, even if it leaves the royal coffers empty.

Beyond the Courtroom

When the candles low, the trial ends, but the game continues in your Private Chambers.

 Rewrite the Law: Use your Law Ledger to toggle the decrees of the land. Make the "Tax on Bastardy" a reality or mandate archery practice for every peasant.

 Reap the Rewards: Reinvest your gold into the Judicial Estate. Upgrade your execution equipment to ensure "efficiency," or build labour camps to turn convicts into currency.

 Medieval Moral Complexity: Navigate a world of deep political intrigue. Will you uphold the strict letter of the law, or will you accept "gold" to look the other way? In the medieval era, justice is rarely blind, and the truth is often a matter of perspective.

 The Kingdom: Every choice you make carries a compounding weight. Will your judgements lead the land to flourish in a golden era, or spark an immenent demise?

 Branching Narratives: Your verdicts have ripples. Sparing a thief might lead to a rebellion; hanging a saint might lead to a miracle. Witness the long-term consequences of your judgments across multiple playthroughs and endings.

The evidence is thin, the rope is thick, and the King is waiting. What is your verdict?

store_data.about_the_game:
Blackout Protocol is a systems-driven sci-fi survival prototype where you must restore power, stabilise a damaged spacecraft, and bring critical ship systems back online before time runs out.

Restore the Ship

Start with minimal emergency power and bring the ship back online step by step. View the spacecraft from a top-down 3D view while interacting with ship devices, control panels, alerts, and camera feeds.

Use In-World Ship Interfaces

You are aboard a damaged vessel drifting towards danger. The ship is dark, unstable, and running on limited emergency power. To survive, you must inspect ship systems, restore power flow, activate key devices, and bring the vessel back under control before it is too late. The layout is designed to make the ship’s systems readable while keeping the experience focused on restoring power and stabilising the vessel.

Manage Limited Power

Every active system matters. Lights, consoles, batteries, generators, and ship systems all affect the power state, so careless use can slow recovery or leave critical systems unavailable.

Explore a Modular Sci-Fi Vessel

The ship is hand crafted with a mostly intuitive layout where players will need to explore and learn about the different devices and systems on board.

Included Content

Blackout Protocol currently includes one focused emergency recovery scenario designed for a short play session, usually around 5–20 minutes depending on player skill and experience.  You will die.....

Immerse yourself in the melancholic aesthetics of a bygone era: listen to the monotonous hum of an old refrigerator, count small change, and watch the night life of the foggy neighborhood unfold.

If you are feeling like making your friends explode with rage while you are destroying them on the space battlefield, this is the perfect game for you. Combine different upgrades and abilities with milions of build combinations and try to be the one last standing. But fear not, the losing players have an advantage and get more money per round to cach up to your amazing build!

COUCH MULTIPLAYER MADNESS

Explosive Exchange is also a pretty good party game, as you can play with up-to 8 players.

USE YOUR ENVIRONMENT

store_data.about_the_game:
SINKING INTO THE VOID is a 2D side-scrolling hack-and-slash action game focused on intense battles against powerful enemies.

Players can equip up to three weapons at once and switch between them instantly to adapt to any situation.

Fast-paced combat combines movement, jumping, and dashing with melee attacks, ranged attacks, and abilities.

In addition to guarding enemy attacks, players can perform a precise “Just Guard (Parry)” by blocking at the exact right moment.

A successful parry can stun enemies, reflect projectiles, and completely turn the tide of battle.

Each stage features unique gimmicks and a wide variety of enemies, while boss stages offer even more challenging encounters.

The game also includes time attack elements, encouraging players to refine their routes, optimize their equipment, and push for faster clear times.

Equipment is divided into six slots: Right Hand, Left Hand, Head, Body, Arms, and Legs.

Items come in four rarity tiers: Normal, Rare, Epic, and Legend.

Equipment can also grant a wide range of special effects, such as:

  • Launching fireballs when attacking

  • Increasing damage as HP gets lower

  • Becoming invincible while jumping

By combining these effects, players can create their own unique combat style and build.

Carefully choosing randomly dropped equipment, refining builds, and constantly improving clear records are at the core of the experience.

SINKING INTO THE VOID is an action game designed to keep players saying, “Just one more run.”

【游戏简介】 《六艺：中文填字》不仅是一场考验知识量的头脑风暴，更是一次在指尖静心沉浸的文化巡礼。游戏将经典的汉字填字玩法与极具东方美学的视觉设计深度融合，为热爱文字解谜与百科问答的玩家，开辟了一个古朴雅致、包罗万象的知识世界。

【游戏特色】

📌 以“六艺”为骨，筑万象之基 游戏结构溯源中国古代君子必修的六门功课，构建出“礼、乐、射、御、书、数”六大主题卷宗。

  • 内容恢弘： 涵盖 36 大主题篇章，关卡纵贯古今中外。从历史地理到前沿理工，从诗词歌赋到流行影视，从体育竞技到动漫游戏，知识点无所不包。

  • 挑战升级： 每篇包含至少三个精心设计的填字残局。当你完成前六卷的洗礼，更有终极的第七卷“合”等待开启，挑战你知识储备的极限！

🧩 贴心交互，丝滑解谜体验 为了让玩家专注于思考而非操作，我们设计了极具人性化的辅助系统：

  • 视域聚焦： 当前选中的词条及其对应提示词将同步高亮显示，让你在密集的网格中瞬间锁定目标。

  • 词组连输： 全面支持各类中文输入法的词组连续输入！无需逐个选定方格，输入完整词条即可自动填充，让解谜如行云流水。

  • 温情助攻： 遇到暂时无法攻克的生僻字？点击“提示”按钮即可揭晓。

  • 一键校对： 拿不准填得对不对？随时使用“检查”功能，系统将即时反馈正确性，助你精准破局。

🎨 四季流转，定制视觉美学 游戏内置了“春、夏、秋、冬”四套独具匠心的视觉主题供你自由切换。

  • 从初春的淡绿竹影到凛冬的深邃静谧，每个主题都拥有专属的古典配色与 UI 细节。每一次点击，都如同在宣纸上翻阅一卷精美的水墨画册，让解谜过程成为视觉的享受。

🍃 沉浸式智力禅修 这里没有倒计时的焦虑，没有繁杂的操作负担。伴随着落笔时清脆悦耳的音效，看着错综复杂的网格被正确的字符填满。这不仅是解谜，更是一段属于你自己的、宁静且充满成就感的思维修行。

准备好接受“六艺”的洗礼了吗？落笔生花，就在此刻。

store_data.about_the_game:
Backrooms: Blackhole is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. Somewhere deep within the endless halls, reality begins collapsing into a growing void that consumes light, sound, and everything around it. The deeper you descend, the less the world makes sense — and the harder it becomes to tell what is real.

Play alone or with friends as you explore unstable environments, avoid hostile entities, and uncover the origin of a phenomenon that should never have existed.

Features

  • Dark and oppressive psychological horror atmosphere

  • Online co-op for 1–4 players

  • Proximity voice chat

  • Reactive and unpredictable enemy AI

  • Multiple difficulty modes

  • Stealth-focused survival gameplay

  • Large nonlinear environments with hidden paths and dangers

  • Tension-driven exploration and resource management

  • Dynamic visibility system affected by movement, shadows, posture, and flashlight usage

Important Notes

This game is inspired by the Backrooms concept but presents its own original interpretation rather than strictly following existing community lore. The experience focuses on isolation, fear of the unknown, and distorted environments designed to feel increasingly surreal and hostile.

The game contains flickering lights, disturbing imagery, loud noises, darkness effects, and intense audiovisual sequences that may affect sensitive players.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Last Braincell: Escape is a humorous, asymmetrical multiplayer game in which one player takes on the role of the fugitive, while the others cooperate as the police. The fugitive tries to gather resources, conceal their identity, and reach the escape point, while the officers collect clues, search the area, and coordinate the pursuit.

Main characters:

Fugitive (Orange Braincell)

Clever, chaotic, and definitely way too confident. His goal is to disappear off the map, secure a fake identity, and reach the escape point before the police cut off every possible route. He can improvise, hide in absurd places, and pull off ideas that sound terrible on paper but somehow work.

Police Officer (Blue Braincell)

Alert, stubborn, and fully prepared to search half the map over a single suspicious report. He operates based on clues, tips from civilians, and coordination with other officers. He must quickly assess situations, secure areas, and anticipate the fugitive’s moves before he vanishes across the border. 

Goals in the game :

Prototype build. Release date: TBD. Wishlist now!

store_data.about_the_game:
Idlemoor is a dark fantasy idle RPG set in a persistent online realm of ruined settlements, grim barrows, and slow-burning character growth.

Choose how your character survives: fight enemies, train combat styles, gather resources, craft gear, trade with other players, fight against other players in PvP, and climb the rankings. Progress continues while you are away, but active players can make sharper decisions, react to community events & random events, manage the market, and push deeper into the world.

Core Features

Persistent online progression
Your character keeps advancing over time through server-side saves and account-based progress.

Combat, training, gathering, and PvP battlegrounds
Fight players & creatures, improve combat stats, mine, woodcut, forage, skin animals, and build your character through multiple highly-connected complex gear & stat systems! 

Player economy
Buy, sell, and trade through a shared marketplace where player activity shapes item movement.  Each item is totally unique, and will never drop with identical stats.  Build your character with multiple in-depth skill systems, as well as several stat and gear systems that connect to form a complex meta-game of infinite potential choices!

Community features
Chat with other players, compete on rankings, engage in community events every day, and take part in a persistent realm instead of a purely local idle game.

Idle Pacing
Idlemoor is built for long-term progression: short check-ins, longer grinds, rare drops, and slow accumulation of power.

Spin. Win. Collect. Repeat.

Reel Greed is a slot machine incremental where every win turns into a shower of physical money pickups. Start with tiny payouts, collect every bill you can, and build a machine that grows faster, stronger, and more ridiculous with every upgrade.

Each run gives you new chances to improve your setup. Pick powerful run cards, unlock permanent upgrades, increase your payouts, speed up the reels, and turn small wins into room-filling cash explosions.

The more you play, the more the machine changes. Spins get faster. Rewards get bigger. Coins unlock new paths. Cards create temporary power spikes. Before long, a few harmless payouts can turn into a chaotic pile of money covering the screen.

- Unlock new patterns and stronger upgrade paths

- Pick run cards that boost your current or next run

- Improve coin drops, collection range, and spin speed

- Build combinations that turn simple wins into huge payouts

- Watch money pile up, fade, and get collected

Features

- Money and coin pickups that fall, pile up, and flood the screen

- Permanent upgrade tree with branching paths

- Run cards that create short-term build choices

- Pattern-based slot payouts with scaling multipliers

- Fast, satisfying incremental progression

- Chaotic money explosions from big wins

- Short-session friendly, with plenty of room to keep pushing further

store_data.about_the_game:
Vector Storm is a fast-paced top-down arcade shooter that rewards aggression, precision, and smart builds.

Fight through endless waves of escalating enemies, survive devastating boss encounters, and grow stronger with every

run.

Survive. Build. Repeat.

Each run drops you into an arena that gets deadlier by the wave. Clear enemies to earn credits, spend them in the

mid-run shop on weapons and upgrades, and scavenge gear from fallen bosses. Die, bank your tokens, and come back

stronger.

Build Your Loadout

Equip tiered gear across seven slots — cockpit, wings, boosters, plating, shield, dampener, and weapon bay. Every

piece changes how your ship performs. Stack synergies, push your combo multiplier, and find the build that carries you

deepest.

Five Ships. Five Playstyles.

Start with the balanced Viper or unlock faster, stranger ships as you clear waves. The heavy Bastion regenerates

shields. The Phantom opens with a stealth window. The Ironclad reflects damage back. Each ship demands a different

approach.

Meta-Progression

Tokens earned each run fund permanent upgrades — more health, faster fire rate, bonus starting credits, and more. Sink

enough tokens into the tree and the arena changes with you.

Features

[] Endless wave-based survival with escalating difficulty

[] Seven-slot gear system with tiered boss drops

[] Five unlockable ships with unique passives

[] Deep mid-run upgrade shop

[] Persistent meta-progression across runs

[] Multiple distinct boss encounters

[] 44 Steam achievements

[] Global leaderboards

[*] Procedurally generated adaptive soundtrack
